If a man hides in a secret place, shall I not see him? Am I not He who fills heaven and earth? says the Lord.
I have heard the words of the prophets who prophesy lies in My name, saying, "I have dreamed, I have dreamed."
As for the prophets who prophesy falsely, and who speak the deceit of their own hearts, how long shall this continue?
Their fathers have forgotten My name for Baal, and each one speaks of his neighbor's dreams, to lead My people astray.
The prophet who hath a dream, let him tell his dream; and he who hath My word, let him speak My word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? says the Lord.
በውኑ ቃሌ እንደ እሳት፥ ድንጋዩንም እንደሚያደቅቅ መዶሻ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ስለዚህ እነሆ እያንዳንዱ ከባልንጀራው ዘንድ ቃሌን በሚሰርቁ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
እነሆ ከምላሳቸው ትንቢትን አውጥተው፦ እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ነው በሚሉ ነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤
እነሆ ሐሰትን በሚያልሙ፥ በሚናገሩም፥ በሐሰታቸውና በድፍረታቸውም ሕዝቤን በሚያስቱ በነቢያት ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም፤ አላዘዝኋቸውምም፤ ለእነዚህ ሕዝብ በማናቸውም አይረቡአቸውም፥” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ይህ ሕዝብ ወይም ነቢይ ወይም ካህን፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ምንድር ነው?” ብሎ ቢጠይቅህ፥ አንተ፥ “ሸክሙ እናንተ ናችሁ፤ እጥላችሁማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር” ትላቸዋለህ።
የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም የሚለውን ነቢይንና ካህንን፥ ሕዝብንም ያን ሰውና ቤቱን እቀጣለሁ።
አንዱም አንዱ ለባልንጀራው፥ አንዱም አንዱ ለወንድሙ እንዲህ ይበል፥ “እግዚአብሔር የመለሰው ምንድን ነው? እግዚአብሔርስ ምን ነገር ተናገረ?”
ለሰው ሁሉ ቃሉ ሸክም ይሆንበታልና የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችሁ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጥሩ፤ የሠራዊትን ጌታ የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን የሕያውን አምላክ ቃል ለውጣችኋልና።
ለነቢዩ፥ “እግዚአብሔር ምን መለሰልህ እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረው ምንድን ነው?” በሉ ምን ተናገረ?
ነገር ግን፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም” ብትሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “እኔ፦ የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም አትበሉ ብዬ ልኬባችኋለሁና፥ እናንተም ይህን ቃል፦ የእግዚአብሔር ሸክም ብላችኋልና፥
Therefore, behold, I will forsake you, and I will cast you away from My presence, even the city which I have given you and to your fathers.
And I will bring upon you the desolation of the world, and the ruin that shall not be destroyed, the downfall of the world I will bring upon you.

sections.title: Two baskets of figs, one filled with very good figs, the other filled with very bad figs, which could not be eaten.

verses.text: The king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar, took Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the nobles of Judah, along with the craftsmen and the captives, and brought them from Jerusalem to Babylon. Behold, the Lord showed me two baskets of figs set before the temple of the Lord.
In the first basket, there were very good figs, like the first ripe figs; but in the second basket, there were very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
And the Lord said to me, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” And I said, “I see figs, the good figs very good, and the bad figs very bad, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad.”
The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
“Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
My eyes will be on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; I will build them up and not pull them down; I will plant them and not pluck them up.
And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God, for they shall return to Me with their whole heart.”

And the Lord said, “Like the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad, so will I deal with Zedekiah, king of Judah, his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
I will make them a horror, an evil thing, to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a reproach and a byword, a taunt and a curse in all places where I shall drive them.
And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from the land that I gave to them and their fathers.”

sections.title: The prophecy concerning the fall of Babylon.

verses.text: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በመጀመሪያው ዓመት፥ ስለ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።
ይህንም ቃል ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና በኢየሩሳሌም ለተቀመጡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ፦
“ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሞጽ ልጅ ከኢዮስያስ ከዐሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ባሉት በእነዚህ በሃያ ሦስቱ ዓመታት፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ መጣ፤ እኔም ማልጄ ተነሥቼ ተናገርኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን አልሰማችሁኝም።”
እግዚአብሔርም ባሪያዎቹን ነቢያትን ወደ እናንተ ላከ፤ እነርሱም ማልደው ገሠገሡ፤ እናንተም አልሰማችኋቸውም፤ ለመስማትም ጆሮአችሁን አላዘነበላችሁም።
እርሱም፥ “ሁላችሁ እናንተ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከሥራችሁ ክፋት ተመለሱ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከዘለዓለም እስከ ዘለዓለም ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጣችሁ ምድር ትቀመጣላችሁ አለ።
ትገዙላቸውና ትሰግዱላቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፤ ክፉም እንዳላደርግባችሁ በእጃችሁ ሥራ አታስቈጡኝ።
ለእናንተ ጕዳት እንዲሆን በእጃችሁ ሥራ ታስቈጡኝ ዘንድ አልሰማችሁኝም፥” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ስለዚህ ኀያል እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ቃሌን አልሰማችሁምና፤
እነሆ ልኬ የሰሜንን ወገኖች ሁሉ፤ ባሪያዬንም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን እወስዳለሁ፤ በዚችም ምድርና በሚቀመጡባትም ሰዎች ላይ፥ በዙሪያዋም ባሉ በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ ፈጽሜም አጠፋቸዋለሁ፤ ለጥፋትና ለፉጨት ለዘለዓለምም ዕፍረት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
ከእነርሱም የሐሤትን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምጽና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ፥ የወፍጮንም ድምፅ የመብራትንም ብርሃን አስቀራለሁ።
This land shall indeed be desolate; and for these nations and for the king of Babylon, it shall serve for seventy years.
"And when the seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation for their iniquity," says the Lord; "and I will make the land of the Chaldeans a perpetual desolation."
"And all the words that I have spoken concerning her, I will bring upon this land, as Jeremiah has prophesied concerning all the nations."
"Many nations and great kings shall serve them; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the works of their own hands."

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon the nations.

verses.text: The Lord God of Israel says to you, “Take away the wine of this wrath that has not been poured out from My hand; I will cause all the nations that you contend with to drink it.”
They shall drink and stagger, they shall be in confusion; they shall be utterly consumed.”
And from the hand of the Lord I took the cup; and the Lord caused all the nations that He sent me to drink it to drink it.”

Today, as it has come to pass, they shall be utterly desolate, for the sake of the remnant, I will make desolate Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, and I will cause her kings and her princes to drink.”
The king of Egypt, Pharaoh, and his servants, and his princes and his people, all of them,

and all the people that have been delivered to destruction, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of Philistia; and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines;
Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon;
all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isles that are beyond the sea;
Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who dwell in the farthest corners;
and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the wilderness;
All the kings of the land of the Zambri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;

Those who have drawn near and those who have retreated, all the kings of the north who are with one another, and all the kingdoms of the world that are upon the face of the earth, I will cause them to drink; and the king of Shishak shall drink after them.
And thou shalt say, "Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: 'Drink ye, and be drunken; and spew, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword that I will send among you.'"
They shall drink, and if they say, "We will not drink," then the Lord of hosts shall say, "Ye shall surely drink."

Behold, I begin to bring evil upon the city which is called by My name; and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished, for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.

"Therefore, thou shalt prophesy all these words unto them, and thou shalt say unto them: 'The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter His voice from His holy habitation; He shall mightily roar upon His habitation; He shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.'"
For the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, and He will plead with all flesh; He will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.
Thus saith the Lord of hosts: "Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth."
And in that day, the Lord's shepherds shall be from one end of the earth to the other; they shall not be gathered, but shall be as a pit upon the earth, and they shall not be broken.
Ye shall be ashamed and confounded; for your day hath come, and as a beloved vessel ye shall fall; and ye, O ye shepherds! Do not be silent; and ye, O ye flocks of the righteous! Cry out.
ከእረኞች የማይጠፋ የለም፤ የበጎች አውራዎችም አይድኑም።
እግዚአብሔር ማሰማርያቸውን አጥፍቶአልና የእረኞች ጩኸት ድምፅ፥ የበጎች አውራዎችም ልቅሶ ሆኖአል።
ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ የተነሣ የሰላም ውበት ፈርሶአል።
እንደ አንበሳ መደቡን ለቅቆአል፤ ከአረማውያን ሰልፍና ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ የተነሣ ምድራቸው ምድረ በዳ ሆናለችና።”

sections.title: Jeremiah brought forth a plea for justice.

verses.text: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጣ፤ አለም፦
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ቁም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ለሚመጡት ለይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ትነግራቸው ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገራቸው፤ አንዲትም ቃል አታጕድል።
ምናልባት እያንዳንዳቸው ይሰሙ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ይመለሱ ይሆናል፤ እኔም ስለ ሥራቸው ክፋት ያሰብሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር እተዋለሁ።”
እንዲህም በላቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በፊታችሁ በሰጠኋት ሕጌ ትሄዱ ዘንድ ባትሰሙኝ፥
የባሪያዎችን የነቢያትን ቃል ትሰሙ ዘንድ በማለዳ ወደ እናንተ ብልካቸው አልሰማችሁም።
ይህን ቤት እንደ ሴሎ አደርገዋለሁ፤ ይችንም ከተማ ለምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ ርግማን አደርጋታለሁ።”
ካህናቱም፥ ነቢያተ ሐሰትም፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ኤርምያስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይህን ቃል ሲናገር ሰሙ።
ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ካህናትና ነቢያተ ሐሰት፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ፥ “ሞትን ትሞታለህ” ብለው ያዙት።
በእግዚአብሔር ስም፥ “ይህ ቤት እንደ ሴሎ ይሆናል፤ ይችም ከተማ ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ የሚኖርባትም የለም ብለህ ስለ ምን ትንቢት ተናገርህ?” ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በኤርምያስ ላይ ተሰብስበው ነበር።
የይሁዳም አለቆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከንጉሡ ቤት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጡ፤ በአዲሱም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ተቀመጡ።

And the priests and the false prophets spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, "In your hearing, as you have heard, concerning this city, a prophecy has been spoken, and this man is deserving of death."
And Jeremiah spoke to the rulers and to all the people, saying, "Concerning all the words you have heard, the Lord has sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city."
Now therefore, amend your ways and your deeds; and listen to the word of your God, the Lord; for the Lord will turn away the evil that He has spoken concerning you.
But I, behold, I am in your hands; do to me as is good and right in your eyes.

Yet this word I will speak in your hearing, that truly the Lord has sent me to you; and if you kill me, innocent blood will be upon yourselves and upon this city, and upon those who dwell in it; know for certain.
And the rulers and all the people said to the priests and the false prophets, "This man has spoken in the name of our God, the Lord, and he shall not die."
And the princes of the land rose up and spoke to all the people, saying this.

"Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying: 'Thus says the Lord of hosts: Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.'"

Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Did they not fear the Lord and entreat the favor of the Lord? And did not the Lord relent of the disaster that He had pronounced against them? But we are about to bring great disaster upon ourselves."

Moreover, there was a man who prophesied in the name of the Lord; his name was Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land, according to all the words of Jeremiah.
And the king Jehoiakim, and all his mighty men, and all the princes, when they heard these words, sought to put him to death; but Uriah heard it, and was afraid, and fled, and went to Egypt.
And king Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt; even El Nathan, the son of Achbor, and other men with him to Egypt.
And they brought Uriah out of Egypt, and unto the king Jehoiakim; and he smote him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
Nevertheless, the hand of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

sections.title: Jeremiah, the one who is burdened.

verses.text: In the days of King Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, of Judah, this word came from the Lord to Jeremiah.
Thus saith the Lord, “Make thee bonds and yokes; and put them upon thy neck.”

And to the king of Judah, and to Zedekiah, and to Jerusalem, send them by the hand of the messengers, to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon.”
To their masters, thus shalt thou say unto them, “Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: To your masters, thus shall ye say:”
I have made the earth, and the men and beasts that dwell therein, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I will give it unto him that is good in mine eyes.
And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field also have I given him to serve him.
And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land come; and then many nations and great kings shall serve him.

“As for the people and the kingdom that will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish with the sword, and with famine, and with pestilence, saith the Lord, until I have consumed them by his hand.”

But ye, do not listen to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, “Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon.”
For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and I will drive you out, and ye shall perish.
ነገር ግን ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የሚያደርገውንና የሚገዛለትን ሕዝብ በሀገሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፤ እርሱም ያርሳታል፤ ይቀመጥባትማል።”
ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገርሁ፥ “ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገታችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ፤ ለእርሱና ለሕዝቡም ተገዙላቸው በሕይወትም ኑሩ።
ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይገዛ ዘንድ እንቢ ስላለ ሕዝብ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ አንተና ሕዝብህ በሰይፍና በራብ፥ በቸነፈርም ለምን ትሞታላችሁ?
ሐሰተኛን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና፦ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትስሙ።
እኔ አልላክኋቸውምና፤ ነገር ግን እኔ እንዳሳድዳችሁ፥ እናንተና ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁ ነቢያትም እንድትጠፉ በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።”
ለካህናትም ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርሁ፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሐሰተኛውን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና፦ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ በቅርብ ጊዜ ከባቢሎን ይመለሳል የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያቶቻችሁን ቃል አትስሙ።
እነርሱን አትስሙ፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተገዙ፤ በሕይወትም ኑሩ፤ ይህችስ ከተማ ስለ ምን ባድማ ትሆናለች?
እነርሱ ግን ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ ቢገኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የቀሩት ዕቃዎች ወደ ባቢሎን እንዳይሄዱ ወደ ሠራዊት ጌታ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይማለሉ።”
ስላልወሰዳቸው ዓምዶች፥ ስለ ባሕሩም፥ ስለ መቀመጫዎቹም፥ በዚች ከተማ ስለ ቀሩት ዕቃዎች ሁሉ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦
“የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንንና የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን አለቆች ሁሉ ማርኮ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ባፈለሳቸው ጊዜ፥
Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
And they shall be carried to Babylon; and there shall they remain until the day that I visit them, saith the Lord; and then shall I bring you back to this place.

sections.title: The prophet Jeremiah and the false prophet Hananiah.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ በዚያ ዓመት፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ፥ በአራተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ሐሰተኛው ነቢይ የገባዖን ሰው የዓዙር ልጅ ሐናንያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በካህናትና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ፦
“የሠራዊት ጌታ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ፦ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር ሰብሬአለሁ።
የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከዚች ስፍራ ወደ ባቢሎን የወሰዳቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃዎች ሁሉ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳለሁ፤
ወደ ባቢሎንም የሄዱትን የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ ሁሉ ወደዚች ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር እሰብራለሁና።”
ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም በካህናቱና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በቆሙት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ለሐሰተኛው ነቢይ ለሐናንያ ተናገረ።
ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ እንዲህ አለ፥ “አሜን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርግ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ፥ ምርኮውንም ሁሉ ከባቢሎን ወደዚህ ስፍራ በመመለስ እግዚአብሔር የተናገርኸውን ትንቢት ይፈጽም።
ነገር ግን በጆሮህና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጆሮ የምናገረውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤
ከጥንት ከእኔና ከአንተ በፊት የነበሩ ነቢያት በብዙ ሀገርና በታላላቅ መንግሥታት ላይ ስለ ሰልፍና ስለ ክፉ ነገር ስለ ቸነፈርም ትንቢት ተናገሩ።
ስለ ሰላም ትንቢት የተናገረ ነቢይ ትንቢቱ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት የላከው ነቢይ እንደ ሆነ ይታወቃል።”
ሐሰተኛው ነቢይ ሐናንያም በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ወስዶ ሰበረው።

Hananiah spoke before all the people, saying, "Thus says the Lord: Within two years, I will bring back the yoke of the king of Babylon, which you have broken, and I will set it upon the neck of all these nations." And the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.
And after Hananiah had broken the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying,
"Go, and speak unto Hananiah, saying, Thus says the Lord: You have broken the wooden yoke; but I will make in its place a yoke of iron."

For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "I will put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon; and they shall serve him. I will also give him the beasts of the field."
Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto Hananiah the false prophet, "Hananiah, listen: The Lord has not sent you; but you make this people trust in a lie."
Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will cast you from off the face of the earth; this year you shall die, because you have spoken rebellion against the Lord."
So the false prophet Hananiah died the same year in the seventh month.

sections.title: The letter which Jeremiah sent unto the Jews that were at Babylon.

verses.text: The prophet Jeremiah sent this letter from Jerusalem to the elders who were carried away captive, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon.

This is the letter that was sent to King Jeconiah and to the queen mother, and to the eunuchs, and to the rulers of Judah and Jerusalem, and to the craftsmen and the smiths, after they had departed from Jerusalem.
Jeremiah sent the letter by the hand of Elasa the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, when they were sent to Babylon, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying:
Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, to all who were carried away captive, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:

"Build houses and dwell in them; and plant gardens and eat their fruit; take wives and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters;
and multiply there, and do not diminish. And seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to the Lord for it; for in its peace you will have peace."
For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Do not let your prophets and your diviners who are in your midst deceive you, nor listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them," says the Lord.
For thus says the Lord: "After seventy years are completed at Babylon, I will visit you and perform My good word toward you, and cause you to return to this place."
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord; thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
And ye shall call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

I will be found of you, saith the Lord; and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the Lord; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
"And ye shall say: The Lord hath raised up prophets in Babylon."
The Lord, concerning the throne of David, because he hath not made you to dwell with your brethren, thus saith the Lord to all the people that dwell in this city.
Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence; and I will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence upon them, and will make them a terror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations whither I have driven them.
Therefore, because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the Lord, I will send unto them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, saith the Lord.
Therefore, hear ye the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon.

Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, concerning the false prophecies which they prophesy unto you in My name, saying, “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall slay them before your eyes.”

And from among them that arose, all the men of Judah that are in Babylon shall be as those whom the king of Babylon shall burn with fire, even as he did to Zedekiah and to Achab; thus shall the Lord God do unto you whom He hath called.
For they have done evil in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives, and have spoken words in My name falsely; I know it, and I am a witness, saith the Lord God.
To Shemaiah the Nehelamite, thus speak.

“Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, unto all the people that are in Jerusalem, and to the priests, and to the son of Maaseiah, and to Zephaniah, and to all the priests, send them a letter in My name, saying this.”

Concerning every man that prophesies, and every man that speaks falsely, they shall be taken captive and imprisoned, and the Lord shall make them to be in the house of the Lord as a priest, even as He hath made Jehoiada the priest.
Now why dost thou not rebuke the prophet who is among you, Jeremiah?
He said, “The captivity is long; build ye houses and dwell in them; plant gardens and eat the fruit thereof, for I am sent unto you unto Babylon.”
And the priest Zephaniah read this letter in the ears of the prophet Jeremiah.
And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying thus:
"Thus saith the Lord concerning Ahelmawi, concerning Shemaya, 'Send unto all the prophets, saying, I have not sent Shemaya, yet he prophesied unto you, and caused you to trust in a lie.'"

"Therefore, the Lord saith, 'I will punish Ahelmawi and Shemaya, and their seed; and there shall not be a man among my people that shall see the good that I do for my people; thus saith the Lord; for they have spoken a word of falsehood in the name of the Lord.'"

sections.title: The Lord has given hope to His people.

verses.text: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው። እንዲህም አለው፤
“የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የነገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ በመጽሐፍ ጻፍ።
እነሆ! የሕዝቤን የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ የምመልስበት ዘመን ይመጣልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይገዙአታል።”
እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ላይ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፥ “የሚያስፈራ ድምፅ ትሰማላችሁ፤ ፍርሀት ነው እንጂ ሰላም አይደለም።
ጠይቁ፤ ወንድ ይወልድ እንደ ሆነ ተመልከቱ፤ ስለ ምን ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ወላድ እጁን በወገቡ ላይ አድርጎ፥ ፊቱም ሁሉ ወደ ጥቍረት ተለውጦ አየሁ?
ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነውና፥ እርሱንም የሚመስል የለምና፤ ያ የያዕቆብ መከራ ዘመን ነው፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናል።
በዚያ ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ቀንበርን ከአንገትህ እሰብራለሁ፤ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ለሌላ አትገዛም።
ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም፥ ለማስነሣላቸው ለንጉሣቸው ለዳዊትም ይገዛሉ።
“እነሆ አንተን ከሩቅ፥ ዘርህንም ከምርኮ ሀገር አድናለሁና ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ! አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ! አትደንግጥ፤ ያዕቆብም ይመለሳል፤ ያርፍማል፤ ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፤ ማንም አያስፈራውም።

"I am with you, says the Lord; I will completely destroy all the nations that you have known; but you, I will not destroy completely; I will discipline you in measure, yet I will not leave you unpunished."
The Lord says, "Your sacrifices are not accepted, and your offerings are evil."
There is no one to contend with you; there is no healer for your wounds.

All your friends have forgotten you; they care not for you; because of your great wickedness and your sins that have increased, I have brought upon you the sword of your enemies and the punishment of your adversaries.
Your offerings are not accepted, so why do you cry out? Because of your great wickedness and your sins that have increased, I have done this to you.

Therefore, all who consume you shall be consumed; all who plunder you shall be plundered; those who make you desolate shall be made desolate; and I will give all who plunder you into the hands of those who will consume them.
I will heal your wickedness; I will restore your health, says the Lord; for no one shall be able to compare with you, for Zion has been forsaken, and they have called her a deserted city.
The Lord says, "Behold, I will restore the dwelling of Jacob and have mercy on his dwelling; the city shall be rebuilt upon its own mound, and the palace shall remain as it was.
From him shall come forth the sound of praise and the voice of song; I will multiply them, and they shall not be few.
Their children shall be as before; their witness shall be established before me; and I will punish all who afflict them."

And their leader shall be among them; their ruler shall come forth from their midst; I will gather them, and I will bring them back unto me; and who is he that hath given his heart to return unto me? saith the Lord.
And ye shall be a people unto me, and I will be a God unto you.
Behold, the anger of the Lord is come forth to consume; and the calamity of death shall be brought upon the wicked.
The fierce anger of the Lord shall not turn back until he hath performed the thoughts of his heart; in the latter days ye shall understand it.

sections.title: As the people of Israel return to their land.

verses.text: In that time, the Lord shall say: "I shall be a God to all the children of Israel; and they shall be My people."
The Lord speaks thus: "The people who have escaped from the sword have found grace in the wilderness. Go; do not pursue Israel."
And the Lord has revealed Himself to me from afar; He has said, "I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore, with lovingkindness have I drawn you."
O daughter of Israel, I will build you again; you shall be rebuilt. You shall again adorn yourself with your tambourines and go forth in the dances of those who make merry.
Again, upon the mountains of Samaria, you shall plant vineyards; the planters shall plant and shall eat the fruit thereof; they shall be filled with thanksgiving.
Upon the mountains of Ephraim, those who call out, "Arise! Let us go up to Zion, to our God, to the Lord," shall come forth on that day.
The Lord says thus: "O house of Jacob! Rejoice; shout among the nations; lift up your voice; give thanks; for the Lord has redeemed His people, the remnant of Israel."
Behold, I will bring them from the north country; and I will gather them from the ends of the earth for the feast of Passover; many nations shall be born unto them; and they shall return hither.
As they wander, I will bring them back; I will lead them by a straight way, and they shall not stumble; for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is My firstborn.
O nations! Hear the word of the Lord; and declare it in the distant islands, saying, "He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him as a shepherd keeps his flock."
The Lord hath redeemed Jacob; and from the hand of him that was stronger than he, he hath delivered him.

They shall come; and in Zion, the mountain shall rejoice over them; and unto the Lord their God, with goodness, and unto corn and wine, and unto oil, and unto the flock and the herd, shall they gather; and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
At that time, they shall rejoice with singing; the dancers and the joyful shall be as one; and I will bring them back to joy; and I will turn their mourning into joy.
And I will lift up the bodies of the priests and the Levites; I will bless them; and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the Lord.
Thus saith the Lord: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.”
Thus saith the Lord: “Your voice shall be heard from lamentation, and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, saith the Lord; and they shall return from the land of the enemy.”
For there is hope in thine end, saith the Lord, that thy children shall return to their own border.

“I heard Ephraim bemoaning himself; thus he said: ‘Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke; turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the Lord my God.’”
After I was turned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh; I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

Surely Ephraim is my beloved son; he is a child in whom I take delight; for as often as I speak of him, I do earnestly remember him still; therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.

"Make for yourself a sign upon the way, and set up guideposts; direct your heart toward the path you have traveled, and lead it to the place of rest. O daughter of Israel, return! And as you wander, return to these, to your cities."
"O daughter of the forsaken! How long will you continue to be in anguish? For the Lord has wrought a new thing upon the earth, and man shall turn to his desolation."

sections.title: The wealth that shall come unto the people of Israel.

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, “In the time of my returning, in the land of Judah, in her cities: O dwelling place of righteousness! O holy mountain! They shall again speak of the blessing of the Lord upon thee.”
In the cities of Judah and throughout all her land, those who dwell with the farmers and those who ride upon the horses shall be found.
I have gathered all that are thirsty, and I have taken hold of all that are weak.
Therefore I am awake; I have looked about; and my sleep hath departed from me.
“Behold, the time cometh when I shall sow the seed of man and the seed of beast in the house of Israel and in the house of Judah,” saith the Lord.
Thus shall it be; “I will scatter them and do evil unto them, as they have been scattered; likewise I will work against them and bring them to ruin,” saith the Lord.
In that time, a man shall not say thus: “The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.”
But every man shall die for his own iniquity; every one that eateth the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.
“Behold, the time cometh when I shall make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,” saith the Lord;

“For I brought them out of the land of Egypt, on the day when I took them by the hand, and there was no covenant with their fathers; for they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not,” saith the Lord.

After those days, the covenant that I shall make with the house of Israel, says the Lord: I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

Let not each man teach his neighbor, and let not each man teach his brother, saying, “Know the Lord,” for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the Lord; for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
Thus says the Lord, who gives the sun for light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and the stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar; the Lord of hosts is his name:
“If this law departs from before me, says the Lord, then the seed of Israel shall cease from being a nation before me forever.”

The Lord says this: “If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says the Lord.”
“Behold, the days are coming,” says the Lord, “that the city shall be built for the Lord from the tower of Hananel to the corner gate.”
It shall go out to the plain, and it shall go down to the valley.

And all the valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields as far as the brook of Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy to the Lord; it shall not be plucked up or thrown down anymore forever.

sections.title: Jeremiah, as a field of the earth, like unto a home.

verses.text: In the ninth year of King Zedekiah of Judah, in the tenth month, the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord was this:
At that time, the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and the prophet Jeremiah was confined in the court of the guard, which was in the house of the king of Judah.

King Zedekiah of Judah had been warned, saying, “Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it; why then do you prophesy and say, ‘The king of Babylon will surely come against us?’”

Indeed, King Zedekiah of Judah shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon; he shall speak mouth to mouth with him, and his eyes shall see his eyes; but he shall not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans.
Zedekiah shall go to Babylon, and there he shall remain until I visit him, says the Lord; though you fight against the Chaldeans, you shall not succeed.”
The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
“Behold, your cousin Hanamel, the son of Shallum, will come to you, saying, ‘Buy my field that is in Anathoth, for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.’”

So according to the word of the Lord, Hanamel, the son of my uncle, came to me in the court of the guard and said, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth, for the right of redemption and the right to possess it is yours; buy it for yourself.” Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord.
And I bought the field from Hanamel, the son of my uncle, that was in Anathoth, and I weighed out to him the seventeen shekels of silver.
I wrote the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the silver on the scales.
I have taken the written document of the covenant that was sealed;

The son of my uncle, Anamiel, and the witnesses who have signed the covenant, all the Jews who were stationed at the gate of the prison, have seen that I have given the covenant to the son of Maseh, to Neriah, the son of Baruch.
And before them, I commanded Baruch, saying:
"Thus says the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: 'Let this covenant document, which has been sealed, be kept for many days; place it in a clay jar.'"
"Thus says the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: 'People shall again buy houses and fields and vineyards in this land.'"

sections.title: The Prayer of Jeremiah

verses.text: After I gave the scroll to Baruch, the son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord, saying:
"Alas! O Lord God! Behold, You have created the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for You."
"O great and mighty God! You perform great mercies for many thousands; and You repay the iniquity of the fathers upon their children after them."

"O Lord, You are great in counsel and mighty in work; for Your name is great, mighty, and able to do all things. O Lord, You give to all according to their ways and according to the fruit of their deeds; Your eyes are open upon all the ways of the children of men."
"Even to this day, You have made signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and also among Israel and among other people; as You have done until this day, You have made a name for Yourself."
"By signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terror, You brought forth Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt."
"And You gave them the land concerning which You swore to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."
"But they came in and possessed it; yet they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law; they did nothing of all that You commanded them to do; therefore, You brought upon them all this evil."
"And the people gathered and took this city; and this city was taken by the hand of the Chaldeans, as You have spoken."

"And You, O Lord God, have given the field for money; and I have written a deed of purchase; and I have sealed it; and I have taken witnesses; and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans."
And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying,
“Behold, I am the Lord God of all flesh; is there anything too hard for me?”
Therefore, thus saith the Lord: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

And the Chaldeans that fight against this city shall come and set fire to this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth; for the children of Israel have done nothing but provoke me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the Lord.
And I will remove them from before my face, this city has been in my wrath and in my fury since the day that they built it, even unto this day.

And it is because of me that they have provoked me, they and their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for all the evil that they have done against the children of Israel and against the children of Judah.
And they have not turned their backs to me, but their faces; and I have risen up early and sent unto them, but they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
And they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.

sections.title: Trustworthy hope

verses.text: አሁን እንግዲህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር አንተ ስለ እርስዋ፥ “በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ትሰጣለች ስለምትላት ከተማ እንዲህ ይላል፦
እነሆ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ፥ በታላቅም መቅሠፍቴ እነርሱን ካሳደድሁባት ሀገር ሁሉ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ ተዘልለውም እንዲኖሩ አደርጋለሁ፤
እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።
ለእነርሱም፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ ለዘለዓለም እንዲፈሩኝ ሌላ መንገድና ሌላ ልብ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።
ከእነርሱም እንዳልመለስ፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር የዘለዓለምን ቃል ኪዳን እገባለሁ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ ፈቀቅ እንዳይሉ መፈራቴን በልባቸው ውስጥ አኖራለሁ።
ለእነርሱም መልካምን በማድረግ ይቅር እላቸዋለሁ፤ በእውነትም በፍጹም ልቤና በፍጹም ነፍሴ በዚህች ምድር እተክላቸዋለሁ።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ይህን እጅግ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንዳመጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ የተናገርሁላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ አመጣላቸዋለሁ።
እናንተም፦ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት፤ ለከለዳውያንም እጅ ተሰጥታለች በምትሉአት ምድር እርሻን እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።
ምርኮኞቻቸውንም እመልሳለሁና በብንያም ሀገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች በደጋውም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ በቆላውም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ ሰዎች እርሻውን በብር ይገዛሉ፤ በውሉም ወረቀት ፈርመው ያትማሉ፤ ምስክሮችንም ያቆማሉ፤” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

sections.title: The second comforting hope.

verses.text: ኤርምያስ ገና በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ሳለ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት፦
“ስሙ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ፥ ምድርን የፈጠራት፥ የሠራትና ያጸናት እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦
ወደ እኔ ጩኽ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አንተም የማታውቀውን ታላቅና ኀይለኛ ነገርን እነግርሃለሁ።
የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለምሽግና ለመከላከያ ስለ ፈረሱት ስለዚህች ከተማ ቤቶች፥ ስለ ይሁዳም ነገሥታት ቤቶች እንዲህ ይላልና፦
የከለዳውያን ተዋጊዎች ለመዋጋት መጥተዋል፤ ነገር ግን በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ በገደልኋቸው ሰዎች ሬሳዎች እሞላታለሁ፥ ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፊቴን ከዚህች ከተማ እመልሳለሁ።
እነሆ ፈውስንና መድኀኒትን እሰጣታለሁ፤ እፈውሳታለሁም፤ የሰላምንና የእውነትንም መንገድ እገልጥላቸዋለሁ።
የይሁዳን ምርኮኞች፥ የእስራኤልንም ምርኮኞች እመልሳለሁ፤ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበሩ አድርጌ እሠራቸዋለሁ።
እኔንም ከበደሉበት ኀጢአት ሁሉ አነጻቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም የበደሉኝንና ያመፁብኝን ኀጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር እላለሁ።
ይህችም ከተማ እኔ የምሠራላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ በሚሰሙ፥ እኔም ስላመጣሁላቸው በጎነትና ሰላም ሁሉ በሚፈሩና በሚደነግጡ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ለደስታ፥ ለክብርና ለገናንነት ትሆናለች።”
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “እናንተ፦ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት በምትሉአት በዚች ስፍራ፥ የሚቀመጥባቸው በሌለ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባድማ በሆኑ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ፥

The voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride: For the Lord is good; His mercy endures forever. The voice of those who bring offerings into the house of the Lord, saying, "Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His mercy endures forever," shall be heard again. Thus says the Lord: "I will restore the fortunes of this land to what they were at first."

Thus says the Lord of hosts: "In desolation, where there is neither man nor beast, this place shall become a dwelling for dragons, and in all the cities shall be desolate, and the places where they dwell shall be laid waste."

In the cities that are desolate, in the cities that are forsaken, in the cities of the south, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, they shall again be inhabited, says the Lord."
"Behold, the good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and the house of Judah shall come to pass in those days; thus says the Lord."
In those days, at that time, I will cause a righteous Branch to spring up for David; and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land."
In those days, Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely; and this is the name by which it will be called: 'The Lord is our righteousness.'"
Thus says the Lord: "A man shall not fail to sit on the throne of David in Israel."
And the offerings that are presented, and the sacrifices of the grain, and the burnt offerings, shall not be taken away from before Me; and he who serves continually shall not fail before Me."
The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:"
"Thus says the Lord: If you can break My covenant of the day and My covenant of the night, so that there shall not be day and night in their season,"
"Let it not be that the son who sits upon His throne is not like my servant David; and the covenant which is with my ministers, the Levites, shall also be broken."
"As it is impossible to count the host of heaven, and as it is impossible to measure the sand of the sea, so have I multiplied the seed of my servant David and those who serve me."
"The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:"
"This people: The Lord has called both of the chosen tribes, and thus He has made my people a division, that they may not be a people from now on; do you not regard what is before them?"
"The Lord says: As I have not broken the covenant of day and night, nor the ordinances of heaven and earth, so shall I not cast away the seed of Jacob."
"And I too will make them rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that I may not cast away their seed; I will restore their fortunes, and I will have mercy upon them."

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Zedekiah.

verses.text: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ ከእጁም ግዛት በታች ያሉ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ኢየሩሳሌምንና የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ ይወጉ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው፦
“የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ሂድ፤ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በለው፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ ይች ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ተላልፋ ትሰጣለች፤ ይይዛታል፤ በእሳትም ያቃጥላታል።
አንተም በርግጥ ትያዛለህ፤ በእጁም አልፈህ ትሰጣለህ እንጂ ከእጁ አታመልጥም፤ ዐይንህም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ዐይን ታያለች፤ እርሱም ከአንተ ጋር አፍ ለአፍ ይናገራል፤ ወደ ባቢሎንም ትገባለህ።
“ነገር ግን የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ሆይ! የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አንተ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በሰይፍ አትሞትም፤
ነገር ግን በሰላም ትሞታለህ፥ ከአንተ በፊት እንደ ነበሩ እንደ ዱሮ ነገሥታት አባቶችህ እሳት ይቃጠልላቸው እንደ ነበር እንዲሁ ያቃጥሉልሃልና፦ ወየው! ጌታ ሆይ! እያሉ ያለቅሱልሃል፤ እኔ ቃልን ተናግሬአለሁና” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ነገረው።
የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምንና የቀሩትን የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ለኪሶንና አዚቃንም ይወጋ ነበር። እነዚህ የተመሸጉ ከተሞች በይሁዳ ከተሞች መካከል ቀርተው ነበርና።

sections.title: Concerning the freedom of servants.

verses.text: ስለ አርነታቸው ዐዋጅ እንዲነግር ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ከአደረገ በኋላ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።
ሰው ሁሉ ዕብራዊ የሆነ ወንድ ባሪያውንና ዕብራዊት የሆነች ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ፥ አይሁዳዊ ወንድሙንም ማንም እንዳይገዛ፤
ሰው ሁሉ ወንድ ባሪያውንና ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ማንም እንዳይገዛቸው ወደ ቃል ኪዳኑ የገቡ አለቆች ሁሉና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰሙ፤ አርነትም አወጡአቸው።
ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ ተመልሰው አርነት ያወጡአቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸውን አስመለሱ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም አድርገው ገዙአቸው።
ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ አባቶቻችሁን ከባርነት ቤት ከግብፅ ሀገር በአወጣኋቸው ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዲህ ስል ቃል ኪዳን አደረግሁ፦
ስድስት ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የተሸጠላችሁን፥ ስድስትም ዓመት የተገዛላችሁን ዕብራዊ ወንድማችሁን እያንዳንዳችሁ አርነት ታወጡታላችሁ፤ አባቶቻችሁ ግን አልሰሙኝም፤ ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።
እናንተም ዛሬ ተመልሳችሁ ሰው ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን አርነት ለማውጣት ዓመተ ኅድገትን በማድረግ በዐይኔ ፊት ቅን የሆነውን ነገር አድርጋችሁ ነበር፤ ስሜም በሚጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጋችሁ ነበር።
ነገር ግን ተመልሳችሁ ስሜን አስነቀፋችሁ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፈቃዳቸው እንዲሄዱ አርነት ያወጣችኋቸውን ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎቻችሁን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎች እንዲሆኑላችሁ መለሳችኋቸው።”
ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ሰው ሁሉ ለወንድሙና ለባልንጀራው ዓመተ ኅድገትን ለማድረግ እኔን አልሰማችሁም፤ እነሆ እኔ ለሰይፍና ለቸነፈር፥ ለራብም ዓመተ ኅድገትን አውጅባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል እበትናችኋለሁ።

I shall give them a sign, for those who have transgressed My covenant and have not fulfilled the word of My covenant before Me, and I shall cast them away like the chaff that is blown away in the midst of the wind.
The leaders of Judah and the leaders of Jerusalem, the captains and the priests, and all the people of the land who have passed through the chaff in the midst of the wind.

I shall give them into the hand of their enemies, and their souls shall be delivered into the hand of those who seek to destroy them; their carcasses shall be for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth to consume.

And I shall give the king of Judah, Zedekiah, and his princes into the hand of their enemies; their souls shall be delivered into the hand of those who seek to destroy them, and I shall give them into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, which has returned from you.

Behold, I shall bring distress, saith the Lord; and I shall return them to this land; they shall be consumed; they shall be taken captive; and by fire shall they be burned; and I shall make it a desolation where no man shall dwell in the cities of Judah.

sections.title: Jeremiah and the Rechabites

verses.text: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦
“ወደ ሬካባውያን ቤት ሄደህ ተናገራቸው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት አምጥተህ ከክፍሎቹ ወደ አንዲቱ አግባቸው፤ የወይን ጠጅም አጠጣቸው።”
የከባስንን ልጅ የኤርምያስን ልጅ ያእዛንያንና ወንድሞቹንም፥ ልጆቹንም ሁሉ የሬካባውያንን ቤተ ሰብእ ሁሉ ወሰድኋቸው፤
ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት በበረኛው በሰሎም ልጅ በማሴው ጓዳ በላይ ባለው በአለቆቹ ጓዳ አጠገብ ወደ አለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ጎዶልያ ልጅ ወደ ሐናንያ ልጆች ጓዳ አገባኋቸው።
በሬካባውያንም ልጆች ፊት የወይን ጠጅ የሞላባቸውን ማድጋዎችንና ጽዋዎችን አኑሬ፥ “የወይኑን ጠጅ ጠጡ” አልኋቸው።
እነርሱ ግን እንዲህ አሉ፥ “የወይኑን ጠጅ አንጠጣም፤ አባታችን የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ለዘለዓለም የወይን ጠጅ አትጠጡ ብሎ አዝዞናልና።
በምትኖሩባት ምድር ላይ ብዙ ዘመን እንድትኖሩ፥ በዕድሜአችሁ ሙሉ በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀመጡ እንጂ ቤትን አትሥሩ፤ ዘርንም አትዝሩ፤ ወይንም አትትከሉ፤ አንዳችም አይሁንላችሁ።
እኛም የአባታችንን የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብን ቃል ባዘዘን ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዘናል፤ እኛም ሚስቶቻችንም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም ዕድሜአችንን ሙሉ የወይን ጠጅ አልጠጣንም፤
የምንቀመጥበትንም ቤት አልሠራንም፤ የወይን ቦታና እርሻ፥ ዘርም የለንም።
በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀምጠናል፤ አባታችንም ኢዮናዳብ ያዘዘንን ሁሉ ሰምተናል፤ አድርገናልም።

Yet, the king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar, came upon this land in the time of the appointed season, saying: "Come, let us rise against the army of the Chaldeans and against the army of Syria, and let us go up to Jerusalem; let us set our siege against it."
And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying:

"Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and speak unto the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying: 'Will you not receive instruction to hearken to My words?' saith the Lord."

The command that Jonadab, the son of Rechab, gave to his sons not to drink wine was fulfilled; for he commanded them, saying, "You shall not drink wine," and they have not drunk wine until this day; and I have spoken unto you in the morning, yet you have not hearkened unto me.

Moreover, I said unto you, "Each one of you return from your evil ways and amend your doings, and do not go after other gods to serve them; then you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers." But you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
The sons of Jonadab, the son of Rechab, have performed the commandment of their father; but this people hath not hearkened unto me.

Therefore, thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: "Behold, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor have they returned when I called them, all the evil that I have spoken against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall come upon them."

And Jeremiah spake unto the Rechabites, saying, "Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: 'Because you have hearkened to the commandment of your father Jonadab, and have kept all his precepts, and have done according to all that he hath commanded you.'"
"Therefore, there shall not be cut off from Jonadab, the son of Rechab, a man to stand before me forever," saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts.

sections.title: Baruch, as it is written, was found in the house of the sanctuary, and the king was troubled by it.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።
“አንድ የመጽሐፍ ክርታስ ውሰድ፥ ለአንተም ከተናገርሁበት ቀን ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከኢዮስያስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ላይ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ ላይ የተናገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ጻፍበት።
ምናልባት የይሁዳ ቤት ከክፉ መንገዳቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ፥ እኔም በደላቸውንና ኀጢአታቸውን ይቅር እል ዘንድ፥ እኔ አደርግባቸዋለሁ ያልሁትንና ያሰብሁትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ይሰሙ ይሆናል።”
ኤርምያስም የኔርዩን ልጅ ባሮክን ጠራ፤ ባሮክም እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፉ ክርታስ ጻፈ።
ኤርምያስም ባሮክን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው፥ “እኔ እስረኛ ነኝ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤትም እገባ ዘንድ አልችልም።
አንተ ግን ገብተህ ከአፌ የጻፍኸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በጾም ቀን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በሕዝቡ ጆሮ በክርታሱ አንብብ፤ ደግሞም ከከተሞቻቸው በሚወጡ በይሁዳ ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ አንብበው።
እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የተናገረው ቍጣውና መዓቱ ታላቅ ነውና ምናልባት ልመናቸው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትደርስ ይሆናል፤ ሁሉም ከክፉ መንገዳቸው ይመለሱ ይሆናል።”
የኔርዩም ልጅ ባሮክ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል በመጽሐፉ አነበበ።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ኢዮአቄም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት በዘጠነኛው ወር በኢየሩሳሌም የተቀመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳም ከተሞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም የመጡ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመጾም ዐዋጅ ነገሩ።
ባሮክም የኤርምያስን ቃል በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በላይኛው አደባባይ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በአዲሱ በር መግቢያ ባለው በጸሓፊው በሳፋን ልጅ በገማርያ ክፍል በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጆሮ በመጽሐፉ አንበበ።
And Micah, the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the book.

And he went into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, namely, Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah; and all the princes were there with them.
And Micah spoke to Baruch, saying, "All the words that you have heard from the book in the ears of the people, declare them."

And all the princes said to him, "Take in your hand the scroll that you have read in the ears of the people, and go to the son of Kushi, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Nethaniah, to Judah, and send it to Baruch." And Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and went down to them.
And they said to him, "Sit down until we have read it in our ears." And Baruch read it in their ears.
And it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they looked at one another in fear and said to Baruch, "We must surely tell the king all these words."
And Baruch said, "How shall we declare to him all these words as you have written?"
And Baruch answered, "Jeremiah spoke all these words to me, and I wrote them with ink in the book."
And the princes said to Baruch, "You and Jeremiah go; hide yourselves, and let no man know where you are."
And they went to the king in the court, and they laid the scroll before Elishama the scribe; and they spoke all the words to the king.

And the king sent for his servant, and he brought Judah; and he was from the house of Elishama, the scribe; and Judah stood before the king and all the princes who were around the king, and they listened.
And the king was sitting in the house of winter in the ninth month; and before him, a fire was burning.
And Judah was counted as three and four columns; the king had made a great fire, and he burned his servant in the midst of the fire until it was consumed, and he cast him into the fire.
And the king, all the servants who heard these words, did not tremble; nor did they rend their garments.
Nevertheless, Elanathan and Gedaliah, and Gemariah sought to prevent the king from burning his servant; but he did not listen to them.

And the king commanded Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet to take the king's son and to spare him, and the son of Azriel, Saraiah, and the son of Abdeel, Shelemiah; but the Lord had delivered them.

sections.title: The book that was sealed is as it were written anew.

verses.text: And it came to pass, after Baruch had written the words from the mouth of Jeremiah upon a scroll, that the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying thus:
"And let another scroll be taken; and let Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, write therein all the former words that were in the scroll which Jehoiakim burned."

Thus spoke the Lord concerning Jehoiakim, king of Judah: "The Lord saith thus: Thou shalt surely see the king of Babylon come; and he shall destroy this land; and man and beast shall be consumed. Why dost thou write this scroll, saying, 'It shall not come to pass'?"

Therefore, concerning Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the Lord saith thus: "There shall not be a man to sit upon the throne of David; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost."

And for their iniquity, I will bring upon him and upon his seed and upon his servants a great evil; and they shall not hearken, and all the evil that I have spoken concerning them shall come upon them and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem and upon the men of Judah."

And Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch, the son of Neriah, the scribe; and he wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim, the king of Judah, had burned in the fire; and there were added besides unto them many like words.

sections.title: The inquiry that Zedekiah presented to Jeremiah.

verses.text: The king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar, spoke against Judah, concerning Jehoiakim's son, Zedekiah, who was a descendant of Jehoiakim, in the land of Coniah.
Yet he and his servants, and the people of the land, did not heed the words of the Lord which were spoken by the prophet Jeremiah.
And the king Zedekiah sent to Jeremiah, saying, "Pray for us to our God, the Lord," and he sent to the prophet Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, the priest.
They did not yet take him into custody in the house of confinement, for Jeremiah was to go out among the people.
And the army of Pharaoh went out from Egypt; and when they heard tidings of them, they returned from Jerusalem.
And the word of the Lord came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying:

Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "When you send to me, saying, 'Thus shall you speak to the king of Judah,' say to him: 'Behold, the army of Pharaoh, which has come out to help you, shall return to their own land, to Egypt.'"
And the men of the city shall return; they shall take this city; they shall burn it with fire.
The Lord says: "Do not go forth; for they shall surely return to us, saying, 'You will not be able to withstand them.'"
But if you should defeat all the forces of the Chaldeans that come against you, and only a few of them remain, they shall rise up in their place; and this city shall be burned with fire."
And the army of the Chaldeans arose against Pharaoh's army, and when they had lifted themselves up, they returned from Jerusalem.
Jeremiah went forth from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin, to dwell among the people.

And at the gate of Benjamin, there was a certain gatekeeper, whose name was Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Hananiah; and he said, "You are going to fall into the hands of the Chaldeans." Thus he seized the prophet Jeremiah.
But Jeremiah said, "It is a lie; I am not going to fall into the hands of the Chaldeans." Yet he did not listen to him; and Seraiah took Jeremiah and brought him to the princes.
And the princes were angry with Jeremiah and struck him; and they put him in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for they had made that the prison.
And Jeremiah entered into the dungeon, and there he remained many days.

And King Zedekiah sent and took him, and the king asked him in his house secretly, saying, "Is there any word from the Lord?" And Jeremiah said, "There is; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
And Jeremiah said to the king Zedekiah, "What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?"
The king of Babylon shall not come against you nor against this land, thus your prophets have prophesied to you; where are they?
Now, O king, let my supplication come before you; do not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there."

And King Zedekiah commanded; and Jeremiah was confined in the court of the prison, and there was given him daily a piece of bread out of the baker's street, until all the bread in the city was spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
ኤርምያስ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል የተናገረውን ቃል የናታን ልጅ ሰፋንያስ፥ የጳስኮርም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ፥ የሰሌምያም ልጅ ዮካል፥ የመልክያም ልጅ ጳስኮር ሰሙ።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “በዚች ከተማ የሚቀመጥ በሰይፍና በራብ፥ በቸነፈርም ይሞታል፤ ወደ ከለዳውያን የሚወጣ ግን በሕይወት ይኖራል፤ ነፍሱም እንደ ምርኮ ትሆንለታለች፤ በሕይወትም ይኖራል።
እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ይች ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት እጅ በርግጥ ትሰጣለች፤ እርሱም ይይዛታል።”
አለቆቹም ንጉሡን፥ “ይህን የመሰለውን ቃል ሲነግራቸው በዚያች ከተማ የቀሩትን የሰልፈኞቹን እጅ፥ የሕዝቡንም ሁሉ እጅ ያደክማልና ይህ ሰው ይገደል፤ ለዚህ ሕዝብ ክፋትን እንጂ ሰላምን አይመኝለትምና” አሉት።
ንጉሡም ሴዴቅያስ፥ “ንጉሡ በእናንተ ላይ ምንም ሊያደርግ አይችልምና እነሆ በእጃችሁ ነው” አለ።
ኤርምያስንም ወሰዱት፤ በግዞት ቤትም አደባባይ ወደ ነበረው ወደ ንጉሡ ልጅ ወደ መልክያ ጕድጓድ ውስጥ ጣሉት፤ ኤርምያስንም በገመድ አወረዱት። በጕድጓዱም ውስጥ ጭቃ እንጂ ውኃ አልነበረበትም፤ ኤርምያስም ወደ ጭቃው ውስጥ ገባ።
በንጉሡም ቤት የነበረው ጃንደረባ ኢትዮጵያዊው አቤሜሌክ ኤርምያስን በጕድጓድ ውስጥ እንደ ጣሉት ሰማ።
ንጉሡም በብንያም በር ተቀምጦ ነበር። አቤሜሌክም ከንጉሡ ቤት ወጥቶ ለንጉሡ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገረው፥
“ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ! እነዚህ ሰዎች ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን በጕድጓድ ውስጥ በመጣላቸው በእርሱ ላይ በአደረጉት ሁሉ ክፉ አድርገዋል፤ በከተማዪቱም ውስጥ እንጀራ ስለሌለ በዚያ በራብ ይሞታል።”
ንጉሡም ኢትዮጵያዊዉን አቤሜሌክን፥ “ከአንተ ጋር ሠላሳ ሰዎች ከዚህ ውሰድ፤ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም ሳይሞት ከጕድጓድ አውጣው” ብሎ አዘዘው።
And Abimelech went forth with men, and entered into the king's house, beneath the place of the storehouse; and there he took a linen cloth and a rope, and he cast them into the pit.
And the Ethiopian Abimelech said unto Jeremiah, "Put these cloths under thy armpits," and Jeremiah did so.
And they took Jeremiah and cast him into the pit; and they brought him out from the dungeon, and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
And the king Zedekiah sent and brought Jeremiah unto him into the house of the Lord, to the third entry; and the king said unto Jeremiah, "I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me."
And Jeremiah said unto the king Zedekiah, "If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?"
And the king Zedekiah swore unto Jeremiah, saying, "As the Lord liveth, who made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life."

Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, "Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel: If thou wilt surely go forth unto the king of Babylon's princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house."

But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand."
And the king Zedekiah said unto Jeremiah, "I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me."
And Jeremiah said, "They shall not deliver thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the Lord, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live."
"You shall not go out, for thus says the Lord, 'This is the word that I have shown you.'"

"Behold, all the women who remain in the house of Judah shall be brought forth to the princes of the king of Babylon; and those women shall say, 'Your companions do not comfort you; they have deceived you; but your feet, now that they have sunk in the mire, they will turn back from you.'"

"They shall carry away your wives and your children to Babylon; and you shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon, but you shall not escape from his hand; for this city shall be burned with fire."
"And Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, 'Let no man know of these words, lest you die.'"

"But the princes, if they hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you and say, 'Tell us what the king said to you; do not hide it from us,' you shall not be afraid of them; and we will not deliver you to them; and if they say to you, 'Tell us what you said to the king,' do not be afraid."
"And he said to them, 'Do not return to the house of Jonathan, lest I die before the king.'"
"And all the princes came to Jeremiah and asked him; and the king had commanded them to speak thus. But they did not listen to him, and they ceased to speak with him."
"And Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken."

sections.title: The Desolation of Jerusalem

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and besieged it.
In the ninth year of the reign of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.

And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, and all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

And it came to pass that when Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, they fled, and went forth by night through the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls; and he went out toward the plain.

But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon.
And the Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

sections.title: Jeremiah as it is written.

verses.text: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር የአዛዦች አለቃ ናቡዛርዳንን ስለ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው፦
“ውሰደውና በመልካም ተመልከተው፤ የሚልህንም ነገር አድርግለት እንጂ ክፉን ነገር አታድርግበት።”
የአዛዞች አለቃ ናቡዛርዳንም ላከ፤ ናቡሻዝባንም፥ ራፋስቂስም፥ ኔርጋል ሴራአጼርም፥ ራብማግም፥ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ አለቆች ሁሉ ላኩ።
ኤርምያስንም ከግዞት ቤቱ አደባባይ አወጡት፤ ወደ ቤቱም ይወስደው ዘንድ ለሳፋን ልጅ ለአኪቃም ልጅ ለጎዶልያስ ሰጡት፤ እንዲህም በሕዝብ መካከል ተቀመጠ።

sections.title: A promise given to Abimelech.

verses.text: And while he was at the entrance of the court, the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying:

"Go to the Ethiopian, to Abimelech, and say unto him: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: Behold, I bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee."
"In that day, I will deliver thee, saith the Lord; and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid."
"For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be as a prize unto thee, because thou hast put thy trust in me," saith the Lord.

sections.title: Jeremiah was with Gedaliah as he was appointed.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when Nabuzardan, the captain of the guard, who served the king of Babylon, had taken Jerusalem and Judah, that the word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord was this:
And the captain of the guard sent for Jeremiah, and said unto him, “The Lord thy God hath spoken this evil against this place.”
And the Lord did as He had spoken; for ye have sinned against Him, and His word ye have not hearkened unto; therefore this thing hath come upon you.

Now behold, I have this day set before thee the choice of going with me to Babylon, which may seem good unto thee; but if thou dost not see it as good to go with me to Babylon, then abide here; consider, for behold, all the land is before thee; whither it seemeth good and right unto thee to go, thither go.

And he said, “Go to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go whither it seemeth good unto thee.” And the captain of the guard gave him provisions and a reward, and let him go.
So Jeremiah went unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

sections.title: And Gedaliah, being the governor of Judah, was slain.

verses.text: And all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor over the land, and that he had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon.

And there came unto Gedaliah to Mizpah Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maachathite, they and their men.
And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto them, “Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.”
And, behold, I dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans which come unto us: but ye gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

Moreover, all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor over the land, and they came to Gedaliah unto Mizpah.
And all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

sections.title: The assassination of Gedaliah.

verses.text: የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ በየሜዳውም የነበሩ የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ወደ መሴፋ መጥተው፦
“የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ በኣሊስ ይገድልህ ዘንድ የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን እንደ ላከ ታውቃለህን?” አሉት። የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ግን አላመናቸውም።
የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ “እባክህ፥ ልሂድ፤ ማንም ሳያውቅ የናታንያን ልጅ እስማኤልን ልግደለው፤ ወደ አንተ የተሰበሰቡ አይሁድ ሁሉ እንዲበተኑ፥ የይሁዳም ቅሬታ እንዲጠፋ ነፍስህን ስለ ምን ይገድላል?” ብሎ በመሴፋ በቈይታ ለጎዶልያስ ተናገረ።
የአኪቃም ልጅ ጎዶልያስ ግን የቃርሔን ልጅ ዮሐናንን፥ “በእስማኤል ላይ ሐሰት ተናግረሃልና ይህን ነገር አታድርግ” አለው።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሰባተኛው ወር ከመንግሥት ወገንና ከንጉሡ ዋና ዋና አለቆች አንዱ የኤሊሳማ ልጅ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ከዐሥር ሰዎች ጋር ወደ መሴፋ ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ መጣ፤ በዚያም በመሴፋ በአንድ ላይ እንጀራ በሉ።
የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ዐሥሩ ሰዎች ተነሥተው የሳፋንን ልጅ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በሰይፍ መቱ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሀገሩ ላይ የሾመውን ገደሉ።
እስማኤልም ከጎዶልያስ ጋር በመሴፋ የነበሩትን አይሁድ ሁሉ፥ በዚያም የተገኙትን ከለዳውያንን ሁሉ፤ ሰልፈኞች ሰዎችንም ሁሉ ገደላቸው።
እስማኤል ማንም ሳያውቅ ጎዶልያስን ከገደለ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤
ጢማቸውን ላጭተው፥ ልብሳቸውንም ቀድደው እያለቀሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ የእህል ቍርባንና ዕጣን በእጃቸው የያዙ፥ ሰማንያ ሰዎች ከሴኬምና ከሴሎ፥ ከሰማርያም መጡ።
የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ከመሴፋ ወጥቶ እያለቀሰ ሊገናኛቸው ሄደ፤ በተገናኛቸውም ጊዜ፥ “ወደ አኪቃም ልጅ ወደ ጎዶልያስ ኑ” አላቸው።
ወደ ከተማም መካከል በመጡ ጊዜ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሰዎች ገደሉአቸው፤ በጕድጓድም መካከል ጣሉአቸው።
በዚያም የተገኙ ዐሥር ሰዎች ቀርበው እስማኤልን እንዲህ አሉት፥ “በሜዳው ድልብ አለንና፥ ገብስና ስንዴ፥ ዘይትና ማርም አለንና አትግደለን፤” እርሱም በወንድሞቻቸው መካከል እነርሱን መግደል ተወ።
እስማኤልም ከጎዶልያስ ጋር የገደላቸውን ሰዎች ሬሳ ሁሉ የጣለበት ጕድጓድ ንጉሡ አሳ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ ባኦስን ስለ ፈራ የሠራው ጕድጓድ ነበረ፤ የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል የገደላቸውን ሞላበት።
እስማኤልም በመሴፋ የነበረውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡን ሴቶች ልጆች፥ የአዛዦች አለቃ ናቡዛርዳን ለአኪቃም ልጅ ለጎዶልያስ የሰጠውን በመሴፋ የቀሩትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ መለሰ፤ የናታንያም ልጅ እስማኤል ወደ አሞን ልጆች ይሄድ ዘንድ ተነሣ።
የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ያደረገውን ክፋት ሁሉ ሰሙ።
ሠራዊቱንም ሁሉ ይዘው ከናታንያ ልጅ ከእስማኤል ጋር ሊዋጉ ሄዱ። በገባዖንም ባለው በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ አገኙት።
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከእስማኤል ጋር የነበሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ የቃርሔን ልጅ ዮሐናንን ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን የጭፍራ አለቆችን ሁሉ ባዩ ጊዜ ደስ አላቸው።
እስማኤልም ከመሴፋ የማረካቸው ሕዝብ ሁሉ ተመልሰው ወደ ቃርሔም ልጅ ወደ ዮሐናን ሔዱ።
የናታንያ ልጅ እስማኤል ግን ከስምንት ሰዎች ጋር ከዮሐናን አመለጠ፥ ወደ አሞንም ልጆች ሄደ።
የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት የጭፍራ አለቆች ሁሉ የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን በመሴፋ ከገደለው በኋላ ከናታንያ ልጅ ከእስማኤል ያስመለሱአቸውን የሕዝቡን ቅሬታ ሁሉ፥ ከገባዖን ያስመለሱአቸውን ኀያላን ሰልፈኞችን፥ ሴቶችንም፥ ልጆችንም፥ ጃንደረቦችንም ወሰዱ፤
ተነሥተውም ወደ ግብፅ ይሄዱ ዘንድ በቤተልሔም አጠገብ በአለው በጌሮት-ከመዓም ተቀመጡ፤
እስማኤል የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በሀገሩ ላይ የሾመውን የአኪቃምን ልጅ ጎዶልያስን ስለ ገደለው ከለዳውያንን ፈርተዋልና።

sections.title: Jeremiah, that he might pray for them, as the people had requested.

verses.text: And all the rulers of the people, even Johanan the son of Kareah, and Izaniah the son of Hanan, and all the people from the least to the greatest came unto the prophet Jeremiah.

And they said unto him, “Let, we pray thee, our supplication be presented before thee; for us, and for all these great calamities, pray unto the Lord thy God; for our eyes are consumed with much less.”
“Let thy God, even the Lord, show us the way wherein we should walk, and the thing that we should do.”

Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto them, “I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto the Lord your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass that whatsoever the Lord shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.”
And Jeremiah said unto them, “Let the Lord your God be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even all the words that the Lord thy God shall send unto us.”
“For whether it be good or whether it be evil, we will hearken unto the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we send thee, that it may be well with us.”

sections.title: The answer that the Lord gave to the prayer of Jeremiah.

verses.text: And it came to pass, after ten days, that the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah.
And Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, took all the people, from the least even unto the greatest, and they gathered them all together.
Thus said he unto them, “If you will surely set your faces to go into Egypt, and go to sojourn there; then the Lord God of Israel shall say thus unto you:
I will turn back from the evil that I thought to do unto you, and I will cause you to dwell in this land; and I will build you up and not pull you down; I will plant you and not pluck you up.”
“Fear not the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the Lord, for I am with you to save you and to deliver you from his hand.”
“I will give you mercy; I will have compassion upon you, and I will cause you to return to your own land.”
“But if you say, ‘We will not dwell in this land,’ and if you will not hearken to the voice of the Lord your God,”
Then you shall say, “We will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell.”
Therefore hear now the word of the Lord, O remnant of Judah! Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: “If you wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there,
Then the sword which you fear shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine whereof you are afraid shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.”

And they shall enter into Egypt, and there shall they dwell; concerning all those who shall oppress them, it shall be thus: by sword and by famine, they shall not be consumed; for I, from their bringing forth, no evil shall remain; no one shall escape.

"Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel: My anger and My fury have been poured out upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and as I have poured it out, so shall it be upon you when ye enter into Egypt; and ye shall be for a terror, and for a curse, and for a reproach, and for a shame; and ye shall see this place no more."
O ye inhabitants of Judah! The Lord hath said, "Do not enter into Egypt," for I have spoken unto you this day, that ye may know assuredly.
And ye shall pray unto your God, and let your God speak unto you all that He hath commanded; and ye shall say, "We will do," and send you unto your God, but ye shall not hearken unto yourselves.
I also declare unto you this day; and concerning all that I have sent unto you, ye have not hearkened unto the word of your God.
Now therefore, go ye and dwell in the place whither ye desire, by sword and by famine, and by pestilence, know ye assuredly that ye shall die.

sections.title: Jeremiah was taken to Egypt.

verses.text: የአምላካቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ለእነርሱ አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር የላከውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ መናገርን በፈጸመ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤
የኢዮስያስ ልጅ ኣዛርያስ፥ የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ ትዕቢተኞችም ሰዎች ሁሉ ኤርምያስን፥ “ሐሰት ተናግረሃል፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር፦ በዚያ ትቀመጡ ዘንድ ወደ ግብፅ አትግቡ ብሎ አልላከህም፤
ነገር ግን ከለዳውያን እንዲገድሉን ወደ ባቢሎንም እንዲያፈልሱን በእጃቸው አሳልፈህ ትሰጠን ዘንድ የኔርዩ ልጅ ባሮክ በላያችን ላይ አነሣሥቶሃል” አሉት።
የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ የጭፍራ አለቆችም ሁሉ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በይሁዳ ምድር ይቀመጡ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።
የቃርሔም ልጅ ዮሐናን፥ የጭፍራ አለቆችም ሁሉ በይሁዳ ምድር ለመቀመጥ ከተሰደዱባቸው ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተመለሱትን የይሁዳን ቅሬታ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።
ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን፥ ሕፃናቱንም፥ የንጉሡንም ሴቶች ልጆች፥ የአዛዦችም አለቃ ናቡዛርዳን ከሳፋን ልጅ ከአኪቃም ልጅ ከጎዶልያስ ጋር የተዋቸውን ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስንና የኔርዩን ልጅ ባሮክንም ወሰዱ።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል አልሰሙምና ወደ ግብፅ ምድር ገቡ፤ እስከ ጣፍናስ ድረስም መጡ።
በጣፍናስም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
“ታላላቆችን ድንጋዮች በእጅህ ውሰድ፥ የይሁዳም ሰዎች እያዩ በጣፍናስ ባለው በፈርዖን ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ሸሽጋቸው።
እንዲህም በላቸው፦ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ፥ ልኬ ባሪያዬን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርን አመጣለሁ፤ ዙፋኑንም እኔ በሸሸግኋቸው በእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ላይ አኖራለሁ፤ ጋሻዎቹንም በእነርሱ ላይ ያነሣል።
And the land of Egypt shall be smitten; for death shall be unto death, and for the sword shall be unto the sword, and it shall be delivered unto destruction.

In Egypt, the houses of the idols shall be consumed by fire; they shall be utterly destroyed; they shall be laid waste; and as a servant puts off his garment, so shall the land of Egypt be laid waste; and thereafter, it shall go forth in peace.
And in the land of Egypt, it shall gather the sun's cities, and the houses of the idols of Egypt shall be consumed by fire.

sections.title: The word of the Lord concerning the Jews who dwell in Egypt.

verses.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Migdol, and in Tahpanhes, and in Memphis, and in the country of Pathros.

"Thus says the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: I will not let all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem and upon all the cities of Judah fall upon you; behold, today they have become a desolation, and there is no inhabitant among them."
This is because of the wickedness they have committed, and they and their fathers have sacrificed to other gods whom they did not know, and they have provoked me to anger.
In the morning, I sent all my servants, the prophets, to them, saying, 'Do not do this abominable thing that I hate.'
Yet they did not listen to me; they did not turn their ears back from their wickedness to stop sacrificing to other gods.
Therefore my wrath and my anger were poured out and kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they have become a desolation and a waste, as it is this day.

"Now the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, says this: Why will you bring upon yourselves this great evil, to cut off from Judah the man and the woman, the infant and the nursing child, from among you?"
To destroy your own selves, and to become a reproach and a byword among all the nations of the earth, why will you provoke me to anger by the work of your hands?
Do you not see the evil that your fathers have committed, the evil of the kings of Judah, and the evil of their queens, and the evil of your own evil deeds?
Even to this day, they have not turned away; they have not feared; they have not walked in my law and in my statutes that I set before you and your fathers.
"Therefore, thus saith the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I will bring destruction upon all of Judah; I will cause my face to be turned against you for evil."

"And they shall go into Egypt, and there shall they dwell; I will bring upon them the calamity of Judah, which they have set before their faces; all shall be consumed; in the land of Egypt shall they fall; by the sword and by famine shall they be destroyed; from the least of them even unto the greatest shall they die by the sword and by famine; they shall be for a terror and for a destruction, for a curse and for a reproach."
"As I have gone up to Jerusalem, so will I go against those who dwell in the land of Egypt; by the sword and by famine, I will go against them."

"To dwell there, they shall return with hope in their hearts to the land of Judah; but those who have come to dwell in Egypt shall not return, nor shall any who have sought to return; none shall return except those who have sought to return."

"And their wives shall know their husbands who have turned to other gods, all the women who have remained there; and all the people who have settled in the land of Egypt, they shall gather in a great assembly to speak unto Jeremiah; and they shall say unto him:"
"Thou shalt not speak unto us in the name of the Lord; we will not hearken unto thy words."

"But we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, have done as we were accustomed in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; we have offered to the queen of heaven, and we have poured out drink offerings unto her; and we have done all that we have vowed to do; at that time we did eat bread and were satisfied; it was well with us; we saw no evil."
"But to offer to the queen of heaven, to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have not done; and we have not been delivered by sword or famine."

"And we have offered to the queen of heaven, and we have poured out drink offerings unto her; in truth, have we not made for ourselves images to worship her? Have we not poured out drink offerings unto her?"
"And Jeremiah spake all these words unto all the people, to the men and to the women, to all the people, saying unto them: Thus saith the Lord."

"And you, and your fathers, and your kings, and your leaders, and the people of the earth, have you not considered the incense that you have offered in the cities of Judah and in the gates of Jerusalem, which the Lord your God has remembered, and is it not in your heart?"

"And the Lord shall not be able to bear the wickedness of your works and the abominations that you have committed; therefore, your land shall be desolate, and it shall become a refuge for wild beasts; even until this day, there shall be none that dwells therein."

"Because of the incense you have offered, and because you have sinned against the Lord, and because you have not heeded the word of the Lord, and because you have not walked in His law and in His statutes, and because you have not obeyed His commandments, therefore, behold, evil shall come upon you as it is this day."
"And Jeremiah spoke to all the people, to all the women, saying, 'Hear the word of the Lord, all you Jews who dwell in the land of Egypt.'"

"Thus says the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: 'You and your wives have spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hands, saying, 'We will surely perform our vows that we have made to the queen of heaven, and we will pour out drink offerings to her.' Surely, you will fulfill your vows, and you will perform your vows.'"

"Therefore, all you Jews who dwell in the land of Egypt, hear the word of the Lord; every man of Judah who dwells in the land of Egypt shall not henceforth call upon the name of the Lord, saying, 'As the Lord lives!' For behold, I will call upon you by a great name,' says the Lord."
"Behold, I will bring upon you not good, but evil; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt shall fall by the sword and by famine until they are consumed."

"And those who escape the sword shall return to the land of Judah, few in number; and all the remnant of Judah who have gone into the land of Egypt to dwell there shall know whose word shall stand, mine or theirs."
"'And this shall be a sign to you, that you may know that I will bring upon you evil in this place, as you have been forsaken by me,' says the Lord."
