"Thus says the Lord: 'As for Zedekiah king of Judah, who has been delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, I will give him into the hand of his enemies, and as I have delivered him into the hand of the king of Babylon, so will I deliver Pharaoh king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life.'"

sections.title: The Lord spoke unto Baruch, saying, "Hope."

verses.text: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት እነዚህን ቃላት ከኤርምያስ አፍ በመጽሐፍ በጻፋቸው ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ለኔርዩ ልጅ ለባሮክ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።
“ባሮክ ሆይ! የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚእብሔር እንዲህ ይልሃል፦
አንተ፦ እግዚአብሔር በሕማሜ ላይ ኀዘንን ጨምሮብኛልና ወዮልኝ! በልቅሶዬ ጩኸት ደክሜአለሁ፤ ዕረፍትንም አላገኘሁም ብለሃል።
እንዲህ በለው፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እነሆ የሠራሁትን አፈርሳለሁ፥ የተከልሁትንም እነቅላለሁ፤ ይኸውም በምድር ሁሉ ነው።
ለራስህ ታላላቅ ነገሮችን ትፈልጋለህን? በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ እነሆ ክፉ ነገርን አመጣለሁና አትፈልጋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን በሄድህበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ነፍስህን እንደ ምርኮ አድርጌ እሰጥሃለሁ።”

sections.title: Egypt hath triumphed over thee in thy pride.

verses.text: በአሕዛብ ላይ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።
በግብፅ ላይ፤ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ በከርኬማስ በነበረው፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም በአራተኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በመታው በግብፅ ንጉሥ በፈርዖን ኒካዑ ሠራዊት፥
“ጋሻና ጦር ያዙ፤ ወደ ሰልፍም ቅረቡ።
ፈረሰኞች ሆይ፥ ፈረሶችን ጫኑና ውጡ፤ ራስ ቍርንም ደፍታችሁ ቁሙ፤ ጦርንም ሰንግሉ፤ ጥሩርንም ልበሱ።
ፈርተው ወደ ኋላ ሲመለሱ፥ ኀያላኖቻቸውም ሲደክሙ፥ ወደ ኋላቸውም ሳይመለከቱ ፈጥነው ሲሸሹ ለምን አየሁ? በዙሪያቸውም ይከቡአቸዋል፥” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ፈጣኑም አያመልጥም፤ ኀያሉም አይድንም፤ በሰሜን በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ በኩል ደክመው ወደቁ።
ይህ እንደ ወንዝ የሚነሣ ውኃውም እንደ ወንዝ የሚናወጥ ማን ነው?
ግብፅ እንደ ወንዝ ይነሣል፤ ከባሕሩም እንደሚታወክ ማዕበል ይሆናል፤ እርሱም እንዲህ ብሏል፥ “እነሣለሁ፤ ምድርንም ሁሉ እከድናለሁ፤ ከተሞችንና የሚኖሩባቸውን አጠፋለሁ።
በፈረሶች ተቀመጡ፤ ሰረገሎችንም አዘጋጁና ውጡ፤ ጋሻም የሚያነግቡ የኢትዮጵያና የሊብያ ኀያላን፥ ቀስትንም ይዘው የሚስቡ የሉድ ኀያላን ይውጡ።
ያ ቀን ጠላቶቹን የሚበቀልበት የአምላካችን የእግዚአብሔር የበቀል ቀን ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ሰይፍ በልቶ ይጠግባል፤ በደማቸውም ይሰክራል፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት በሰሜን ምድር በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ ነውና።
O daughter of the Egyptians! Go forth unto Gilead; take balm for thy healing; for why shouldst thou be consumed with a medicine that profiteth thee not?
The warriors have clashed with warriors, and both have fallen in unity; the nations have heard thy voice; thy lamentation hath filled the land.

sections.title: And he came unto Egypt as he had said.

verses.text: This is the word that the Lord spoke to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the coming of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and concerning the land of Egypt, as it shall be smitten.
"Speak in Egypt; proclaim in Migdal; and in Memphis and in Tahpanhes say, 'The sword is drawn, and it is sharpened; rise up, prepare yourselves!'"
Why do your mighty ones fall? The Lord has not cast them down.
Their multitude has fallen; they have stumbled, one against another; they say to their neighbor, 'Arise! Let us return to our own people, to the land of our birth, from the oppressor's sword.'
And there they called out, saying, "The name of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, is but a noise; he has passed the appointed time."

I am alive, as surely as I dwell among the mountains, like a swift eagle; and as surely as I am by the sea, like a great whale; so shall it surely come to pass, they shall say, 'The Lord God, the King of hosts, is indeed coming.'"
"O daughter who dwells in Egypt! Memphis shall be a desolation, for there shall be none to dwell therein; prepare your goods for exile."
"Egypt is like a beautiful heifer; but destruction shall come from the north upon her."

And those who are appointed to her shall be like the reeds of the river; they shall be turned back, and the day of their destruction and the time of their punishment has come; they shall flee together, they shall not stand firm.
For the army shall be strong, and like the trees of the forest they shall come forth; her noise shall be like that of a serpent, and they shall be like a swift wind.
ሊቈጠሩ የማይችሉ የዱርዋን ዛፎች ይቈርጣሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከአንበጣ ይልቅ በዝተዋልና፥ ቍጥርም የላቸውምና።
የግብፅ ልጅ ታፍራለች፤ በሰሜን ሕዝብ እጅም አልፋ ትሰጣለች።”
የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “እነሆ የኖእ አሞንን፥ ፈርዖንንም፥ ግብጽንም፥ አማልክቶችዋንና ነገሥታቶችዋንም፥ ፈርዖንንና በእርሱም የሚታመኑትን እቀጣለሁ።
ነፍሳቸውንም በሚፈልጉ ሰዎች እጅ፥ በባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ፥ በአገልጋዮቹም እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ እንደ ቀድሞው ዘመን የሰው መኖሪያ ትሆናለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።”

sections.title: The Lord shall tend to His people as a shepherd.

verses.text: "Yet, thou art My servant, Jacob; fear not, O Israel! Be not dismayed; for behold, I will bring thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be at rest, and none shall make him afraid."

"Fear not, O Jacob, My servant! For I am with thee," saith the Lord; "I will utterly destroy all the nations to which I have driven thee, but thee I will not destroy; I will chasten thee in measure, yet will not leave thee wholly unpunished."

sections.title: The prophecy concerning Philistia.

verses.text: And Pharaoh came not to the aid of the Philistines, for the word of the Lord that came unto the prophet Jeremiah was this.

Thus saith the Lord, “Behold, waters rise from the north, and shall be as an overflowing flood; and they shall overflow the land and the fullness thereof, the city and them that dwell therein; and the people shall cry, and all that dwell upon the earth shall wail.”
The sound of the neighing of mighty horses, the rushing of chariots, and the rumbling of wheels; fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands.

This shall come to pass, to destroy all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth; for that day cometh, saith the Lord, to destroy the Philistines and all the remnant of the isles.
Destruction hath come upon the land; it is desolate and laid waste; O ye inhabitants of Enak! How long shall ye be troubled?
O sword of the Lord! How long will it be ere thou be quiet? Put up thyself into thy scabbard; rest and be still.
The Lord hath given a commandment against the land and against the sea, and hath prepared it; how canst thou be still? There thou shalt arise.

sections.title: The prophecy concerning the destruction of Moab.

verses.text: Concerning Moab; thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts: Woe unto her! She is destroyed; Kirjathaim is confounded; it is taken; Misgab is confounded; the mighty are dismayed.

From henceforth there shall be no more praise of Moab; for in Heshbon they have devised evil against her, saying, "Come, let us cut her off from being a nation." Also, thou shalt be brought to naught; the sword shall pursue thee.
A cry of destruction and great calamity was heard from Horonaim.
Moab is destroyed; this also was spoken of in Segor.
They shall go forth in the way of the wilderness, and they have heard the cry of destruction from Horonaim.
"Your shame shall be your own; dwell as a wild ass in the wilderness."
For in thy work and in thy record thou shalt be trusted; and thou also shalt be taken captive; if thou art taken, it shall be with the priests and the rulers in unity.
And the Lord, as He hath spoken, shall bring destruction upon every city; there shall be none that shall escape; the overflow shall be destroyed; the plain shall be laid waste.
Let there be a cry to go forth against Moab; her cities shall be desolate; there shall be none that dwelleth therein.
Let him that doeth the work of the Lord be diligent; and let him that sheddeth blood be diligent in his work.

"Moab has been destroyed; she has been brought to shame in her glory; and her wine is not poured out from vessel to vessel; nor has she gone into captivity; therefore her taste remains in her, and her scent is not changed."

"Therefore behold, the days are coming, says the Lord God, that I will send a famine upon the land; they shall hunger for bread, and they shall thirst for water; and they shall wander from sea to sea, and from north to east; they shall run to and fro, seeking the word of the Lord, but shall not find it."
"The house of Israel shall be as a wandering bird, as a nest which is forsaken; so shall Moab be as a forsaken city."
"You: We are strong and mighty in battle; how do you say?"
"Moab is destroyed; her cities are laid waste; the chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter, says the Lord of hosts."
"The destruction of Moab is near; calamity is coming swiftly upon her."
"All around you, all who know her name: the great one in strength, how has she been broken! Say not to her, 'Do not speak.'"
"O inhabitant of Dibon! Come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you; he has destroyed your strongholds."
"O inhabitant of Aroer! Stand by the way and watch; ask him who flees and her who escapes, 'What has happened?'"
"Moab is destroyed and has gone to ruin; do not weep, cry out; for Moab has perished like a vessel in the Arnon."
Judgment shall come; upon the land of Mesor, upon Kelon, upon Yasana, upon Mephath.
Upon Dibon, upon Nabau, and upon the house of Diblathaim.
Upon Kirjathaim, upon Bethgamul, upon the house of Meon.
Upon Kirjoth, upon Bosra, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, both near and far, judgment has come.
The pride of Moab is broken; his hand is lifted up, thus saith the Lord God.

sections.title: Moab has fallen.

verses.text: "Upon the Lord God, we have taken refuge; let us call upon Him; for Moab shall be brought low under His hand; and He shall be as a vessel in His hand; moreover, it shall be a refuge."
"Is Israel not a refuge for Thee? Or hast Thou found it among the hearts? When Thou speakest of Him, dost Thou not tremble within Thyself?"
"Forsake the cities of Moab and dwell within the world; as a hedge, let her serve as a shelter, as a womb."
"The pride of Moab, and the multitude of her fall, and the arrogance that hath deceived her heart, we have heard."
"I know the work, saith the Lord God; as the measure of strength, so hath He not done."
"Therefore, I shall lament for Moab; for all of Moab, I shall cry out; for the people of Kirhareseth, I shall lament."

"O daughter of the vine! I shall lament for thee, for the lamentation of Jazir is for thee; thy branches have gone forth to the sea; and unto Jazir hath the sea reached; destruction hath come upon thy harvest and upon thy wine."

"Joy and gladness have perished from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and wine hath ceased from the winepress; the treader shall tread no more; the voice of gladness shall be no more heard."

"From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elialah, and even unto Jahaz, their voice hath been heard; from Sigor even unto Horonaim, and even unto Eglath-shelishiyah, it shall reach; for my waters have come to an end."
"Concerning Moab, and upon the wall of her fortification, that which is offered to the idol, I shall destroy, saith the Lord God."
"For that which is forsaken has perished, and therefore my heart cries out like a nightingale for Moab; my heart cries out like a nightingale for the men of Kir-hareseth."
"Upon every man there is a burden; they shall bear their burdens all together; every hand shall be heavy; all shall be weighed down according to their own measure."
"And concerning Moab, as it is of no use, I have made it a vessel of destruction; and upon all the desolation of Moab, there is a decree," says the Lord God."
"How is she turned back! From the destruction has Moab risen; how is she turned back! Moab shall be a terror and a snare to all who are around her."
"Thus says the Lord: 'Behold, she shall be as a lioness; she shall roar against Moab.'"
"The strong ones of Moab are slain; her mighty men are taken captive; and in that day, the heart of the mighty of Moab shall be as the heart of a woman in labor."
"For Moab shall be a desolation before the Lord, and the people shall perish from being a nation."
"O you who dwell in Moab! Fear and terror, and destruction are upon you," says the Lord."
"In the year that I brought this upon Moab, I shall bring her to her end; in fear she shall flee into a pit; and from the pit she shall be taken by destruction," says the Lord."

"From the sword that has escaped, the desolation of Heshbon shall stand; fire shall come forth from Heshbon, and it shall devour the remnant of Sihon; and the children of Moab shall be as those who cry out in despair."
Moab, how you are destroyed! You are laid waste; your sons have been taken captive, and your daughters have gone into exile.
But in the latter days, I will bring back the captivity of Moab,” says the Lord. “The judgment of Moab is up to this point.”

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon Ammon.

verses.text: Concerning the children of Ammon, the Lord God saith, “Shall Milcom inherit Gad, and shall his people dwell in the cities thereof? Or is there no heir?”

Therefore, behold, the time cometh when there shall be a cry of destruction upon the city of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord; it shall be for desolation, and her villages shall be burned with fire; and Israel shall possess that which they have inherited, saith the Lord.

O Heshbon! Thou art laid waste; cry out, ye daughters of Rabbah! For Milcom shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together; make a lamentation, and gird yourselves with sackcloth; wail, and do not hold back.
Who shall come unto me, saith she that trusteth in her wealth, O thou daughter that art secure! Why dost thou boast in the valleys?
Behold, I bring fear upon thee, saith the Lord of hosts; every one of you shall be driven away, and there shall be none to gather the fugitives.
Nevertheless, after this, I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.”
Concerning Edom, the Lord of hosts saith, “Is there no wisdom in Teman? Is counsel perished from the prudent? Is their wisdom vanished?”
O ye that dwell in the dust! I will bring the destruction of Esau upon you, and you shall flee; turn back and dwell in the clefts of the rocks.
And if the spoilers come upon thee, shall they not take away the gleanings? And if thieves come by night, shall they not destroy till they have enough?
But I have made Esau bare; I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself; his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbors, and he is not.
Cast away your poor, for I shall sustain them in life; your mourners shall trust in me.
Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, the people who have not been gathered shall be gathered; and dost thou think thou shalt be delivered? Nay, thou shalt not be delivered, for thou shalt drink.
In the wilderness of Basan, I shall make it a place of refuge and a dwelling place, saith the Lord; and all its cities shall be a desolation forever.
"I have heard from the Lord concerning the nations; gather ye together, and come against her; for a messenger shall be sent to her, saying, 'Rise up.'"
Behold, I have made thee a reproach among the people, and a derision among men.

"O thou that dwellest in the world, who art exalted in the mountains! Thy pride and the haughtiness of thy heart have deceived thee. Though thou makest thy house high as the eagle, I will bring thee down," saith the Lord.
"Edom shall be a desolation; all who pass by it shall be astonished; for all its cities shall be a waste."
As Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities round about them, were overthrown, saith the Lord; so shall no man dwell there, neither shall any son of man abide therein.

Behold, I shall bring upon her a lion from the forest, and a wolf from the wilderness shall come forth against her; I will send a destroyer upon her, for who is like me? Or who shall appoint me a time? Or who is he that shall stand against me?

Therefore, thus saith the Lord concerning Edom, and concerning the inhabitants of Teman: Hearken to the counsel of the Lord, for the little ones shall be brought down, and their dwelling shall be made desolate.
From the sound of their destruction, the earth trembled; and her voice was heard like the voice of the sea.
Behold, it is as a serpent that crawls; and it shall be cast upon the ground; and in that day, the heart of the mighty of Edom shall be as the heart of a woman in labor.
"Concerning Damascus; evil tidings have been heard, and Hamath and Arpad are dismayed; they are troubled; they shall be like the sea that is stirred up; they shall not be able to flee."
Damascus is become feeble; she is turned to flee; and trembling hath seized her; she shall be as a woman in labor.
How is it that you have not forsaken the place and the city which you loved?
Therefore, she shall fall, and her inhabitants shall be cast down; and in that day, all the soldiers shall fall, saith the Lord God of hosts.
I will kindle a fire upon the wall of Damascus; and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-Hadad."

Concerning the king of Babylon, Nabuchadnezzar, for the slaughter of them, and concerning Kedar and concerning the kingdoms of Assyria, the Lord God saith thus: "Arise and go forth to Kedar; and destroy the children of the east."
They shall take their tents and their flocks; they shall carry away their curtains and all their vessels; they shall take their camels for themselves; and round about them shall be destruction.

O you that dwell in Assyria! The king of Babylon, Nabuchadnezzar, hath made you a refuge; and he hath devised evil against you; flee, and go far away; and hide yourselves in the depths of the pit," saith the Lord God.

"Arise; for the place of rest is prepared, and it is laid waste unto that which is established, the door and the gate, and the place of wandering is unto that which is not; only unto the people that is established shall it be given."

"Their herds shall be for the slaughter; and their beasts shall be for destruction; I will send those who are called around them to the winds, and I will bring destruction upon all their doorways," saith the Lord.
"And Assyria shall be the dwelling place of birds, and it shall be a desolation forever; there shall not be a man there; neither shall the son of man dwell therein."

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord shall be upon Elam.

verses.text: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah is this:
"Thus says the Lord God of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might."
"And I will bring upon Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation to which the outcasts of Elam shall not come."

"I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life; I will bring disaster upon them, my fierce anger," says the Lord; "and I will send the sword after them until I have consumed them."
"And I will set my throne in Elam, and destroy from there the king and the princes," says the Lord.
"But it shall come to pass in the latter days, I will bring back the captives of Elam," says the Lord.

sections.title: Concerning the Fall of Babylon

verses.text: Thus saith the Lord concerning the land of the Chaldeans, which was spoken by His prophet Jeremiah.

"Speak unto the nations; proclaim; and let them know their purpose; be not dismayed: Babylon is taken; Bel is confounded; Merodach is broken in pieces; her images are confounded; her idols are broken down; let them say."
My people have been taken from the north; and their land shall be made desolate; they shall find no resting place; from man even unto beast they have fled away.
"And in those days, at that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel and the children of Judah shall come together, going and weeping as they go, and they shall seek their God, the Lord."
They shall seek the way to Zion with their faces thitherward; they shall come and join themselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.

"My people have become lost sheep; their shepherds have caused them to go astray; they have turned them away on the mountains; they have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place."
All that found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, "We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers."
Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans; be as the he-goats before the flocks.

Behold, I will raise up and bring against Babylon a great nation from the north; and they shall set their array against her, and she shall be taken; their arrows shall be as of a mighty warrior, and they shall not return in vain.
The land of the Chaldeans shall be a desolation; all that make mention of it shall be astonished, saith the Lord.

"O you who are laden with burdens! Rejoice, for He has made you glad, and He has brought you joy; and as you stand in the field, you have been established like a stronghold, and like the mighty ones, you have been fortified."
"Your mother is greatly ashamed; she who bore you is confounded; behold, she shall be the least among the nations; a wilderness and a dry land, she shall be desolate."
"She shall be a burden, for the wrath of the Lord has risen against her; no man shall abide in her; all who pass by Babylon shall be astonished; and all her cities shall be desolate."
"You who strike the harp, all you people, surround Babylon; for sin has risen against the Lord, and she shall be forsaken; do not let her escape from destruction."
"Her hands are weary, and she is filled with shame; her gates are broken down; for the Lord has turned away from her, and as her maker has forsaken her."
"Cast away the one who gathers the harvest at the time of reaping from Babylon; for each one shall flee before the sword of the Chaldeans; each one shall hasten to his own land."
"Israel is a scattered flock; the lions have driven them away; the first to devour them was the king of Assyria, and the last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon."
"Therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: 'As I have dealt with the king of Assyria, so behold, I will deal with the king of Babylon and his land.'"
"And I will bring Israel back to their pasture, in Carmel and Bashan; they shall be satisfied upon the mountains of Ephraim and Gilead; their soul shall be refreshed."

"In those days and at that time, says the Lord, I will bring back the captives of Israel, and I will forgive their iniquity; it shall not be found; and the iniquity of Judah shall not be found, for I will pardon them."
“በላይዋና በሚኖሩባት ላይ በምሬት ውጡ፤ ሰይፍ ሆይ! ተበቀዪ፥ ፍጻሜያቸውንም አጥፊ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ያዘዝሁሽንም ሁሉ አድርጊ።
የሰልፍና የታላቅ ጥፋት ውካታ በምድር ላይ አለ።
ምድርን ሁሉ የምትፈጫት መዶሻ እንዴት ደቀቀች! እንዴትስ ተሰበረች! ባቢሎንስ በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ባድማ ሆነች!
ባቢሎን ሆይ! በመከራው ተይዘሽ ጠፋሽ፤ አንቺም ይህ እንደመጣብሽ አላወቅሽም፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተቃውመሽዋልና ተገኝተሻል፤ ተይዘሽማል።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በከለዳውያን ምድር ይሠራ ዘንድ ሥራ አለውና እግዚአብሔር ዕቃ ቤቱን ከፍቶ የቍጣውን ዕቃ ጦር አውጥቶአል።
ጊዜዋ ደርሶአልና ሣጥኖችዋን ከፍታችሁ እንደ ዋሻ በርብሯት፤ ጨርሳችሁም አጥፏት፥ ምንም አታስቀሩላት።
ፍሬዋን ሁሉ አድርቁባት፤ ወደ መታረድም ይውረዱ፤ ቀናቸው ደርሳለችና፥ እነሱን የሚበቀሉበት ጊዜ ደርሷልና ወዮላቸው!
የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን በቀል፥ የመቅደሱንም በቀል፥ በጽዮን ይነግሩ ዘንድ ሸሽተው ከባቢሎን ሀገር ያመለጡት ሰዎች ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።
“ቀስትን የሚገትሩ ቀስተኞችን ሁሉ በባቢሎን ላይ ጥሩአቸው፤ በዙሪያዋ ስፈሩባት፤ ከእርስዋም ሰዎች አንድ አያምልጥ፤ የእስራኤልን ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔርን ተቃውማለችና እንደ ሥራዋ መጠን መልሱላት፤ እንዳደረገችም ሁሉ አድርጉባት።
ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝቷ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፤ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞችዋ ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
O haughty one! The time shall come when they shall speak against thee, for thy day has drawn near; behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts.
O haughty one! Thou shalt be brought low; thou shalt be cast down; there is none to lift thee up; I will kindle a fire in thy trees, and it shall devour all that is round about thee.
Thus saith the Lord of hosts, “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are united in their fall; all that oppress them shall hold them fast; they have said, ‘Let them not rise.’”
Their oppressor is strong; His name is the Lord God, who shall consume the earth, and He shall destroy those who dwell in Babylon, and He shall make known their enemies.
The sword is upon the Chaldeans and upon those who dwell in Babylon; it is upon their wise men and upon their mighty men, saith the Lord.
The sword is upon their warriors; they shall be in anguish. The sword is upon their mighty men; they shall be dismayed.
The sword is upon their horses and upon their chariots; it is also upon the mingled people in their midst; they shall become as women; the sword is upon their treasures; they shall be plundered.
She is a land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols; the sword is upon their walls; they shall be destroyed.

Therefore shall the wild beasts dwell with the jackals; the ostriches shall dwell there; and man shall no more dwell there forever; even to the generations of generations shall there be none to dwell therein.
As the Lord hath overthrown Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
"Behold, a people shall come from the north; a great nation and many kings shall rise from the ends of the earth.

They shall hold the bow and the spear; they are cruel and have no mercy; their voice shall roar like the sea; and they shall ride upon horses, set in array like a man for battle against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them; his hands waxed feeble; anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts; for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee. And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Babylon and upon all the inhabitants of Chaldea all the evil that I have pronounced against it; and they shall be as a desolation.
The noise of the taking of Babylon, the earth is moved; and the cry is heard among the nations."

sections.title: An additional judgment upon Babylon.

verses.text: The Lord saith, “Behold, I will raise up a wind that shall sweep over Babylon and over the land of the Chaldeans, a wind that shall bring destruction and desolation.”
And I will send against Babylon those who are fierce; they shall be fierce against her, and her land shall be made desolate; in the day of trouble, they shall surround her.
Upon the sword and the sword-bearer, the sword shall strike; do not let it be weary for the slain; and let all her warriors be cast down.
Those who are slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans; and those who are thrust through shall fall without.
“Though their land be filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel, yet Israel shall not be forsaken; nor shall Judah be abandoned by their God, the Lord of hosts.”
Flee from the midst of Babylon; let every one of you save his life; be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance; He will render recompense to her.
Babylon hath been a golden cup in the hand of the Lord, that made all the earth drunken; the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
Babylon shall suddenly fall and be broken; wail for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed; forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country; for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness; come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.

"Prepare the instruments of war; fill the shields; for the wrath of the Lord is upon Babylon, and He has stirred up the spirit of the king of the Medes; for His purpose is against the sanctuary of the Lord."

"Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon; make the watch strong; set up the watchmen; prepare the ambushes. For the Lord hath both devised and done that which He spake concerning the inhabitants of Babylon."
"Thou that dwellest by many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, the measure of thy covetousness is at an end."
"Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillars; and they shall lift up a shout against thee."
"He who created the earth by His power, who established the world by His wisdom, and by His understanding hath stretched out the heavens."

"At the noise of the taking of Babylon, the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations; for the Lord shall bring forth the rain, and the clouds shall pour forth their rain; He shall bring forth the wind from the treasures of His storehouse."
"Every man is become brutish in his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them."
"Their works are vanity; and the time of their visitation shall be destroyed."
"The portion of Jacob is not like them; for He is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of His inheritance; the Lord of hosts is His name."
"Thou shalt be as a weapon of war; and I will make thee a great nation; and I will bring down the kings from their thrones."
I shall strike thee, O horse and horseman; I shall strike thee, O chariot and its driver.
I shall strike thee, O man and woman; I shall strike thee, O ruler and the one who eats; I shall strike thee, O mighty and the beautiful one.
I shall strike thee, O rider and the wagon; I shall strike thee, O charioteer and the driver; I shall strike thee, O leaders and the captains.
Concerning all the evils which you have wrought before your eyes, I shall bring upon all who dwell in Babylon and in the land of the Chaldeans, saith the Lord.
"O mountain that destroyest all the earth, behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord; and I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and I will make thee a burnt mountain."
"Neither shall they take from thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but I will make thee a desolation for ever, saith the Lord."

"Do not be dismayed upon the earth; among the nations, lift up a banner; and to the nations, give a command; and to the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz, send forth a command; and let the captains come up against her; let the mighty men of war draw near; let them come up as the locusts."
To the nations, and to the kings of Media, and to all the rulers, and to all the land of their dominion, give a command.
That no man may dwell therein, for the thought of the Lord hath been against Babylon, and the land is made desolate; it hath been made desolate.

The warriors of Babylon have ceased from fighting; they have remained in their strongholds; their strength hath failed; they have become as women; their dwelling places are burned; their bars are broken.
To the king of Babylon, it shall be proclaimed that they shall run, to meet one another; the messenger also shall run to meet the messenger; for her city is taken from door to door.
Her fortifications are broken down, and her gates are consumed by fire; and her soldiers are dismayed.
Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, the Lord of hosts, “The house of the king of Babylon is like a deserted fold; a little while shall come the time of her visitation.”
The king of Babylon hath devoured me; he hath crushed me; he hath made me like an empty vessel; he hath swallowed me like a dragon; he hath filled his belly with my delicacies.
O thou that dwellest in Zion, let the violence and sorrow done unto me be upon Babylon; and let Jerusalem's blood be upon the inhabitants of the land of Chaldea.
Therefore, saith the Lord, “Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.”
Babylon shall be a desolation and a dwelling place for dragons; she shall be a wasteland, and no man shall dwell therein.
In unity, they shall be as lions; and as young lions, they shall roar.
In the time of their heat, I will cause them to slumber; and the everlasting sleep shall come upon them; I will make them drunk; and after that, they shall not awaken, saith the Lord.
As the young lions and as the great goats, so will I bring them down to the slaughter.
“የምድርም ሁሉ ክብር እንዴት ተያዘች! እንዴትስ ተወሰደች! ባቢሎን በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ለጥፋት ሆነች!
ባሕር በባቢሎን ላይ ወጣ፤ በሞገዱም ብዛት ተከደነች።
ከተሞችዋ ባድማና ደረቅ ምድር፥ ሰውም የማይቀመጥበት፥ የሰውም ልጅ የማያልፍበት ምድር ሆኑ።
በባቢሎንም ላይ እበቀላለሁ፤ የዋጠችውንም ከአፍዋ አስተፋታለሁ፤ አሕዛብም ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ እርስዋ አይሰበሰቡም፤ የባቢሎንም ቅጥሮች ይወድቃሉ።
“ሕዝቤ ሆይ! ከመካከልዋ ውጡ፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ራሳችሁን አድኑ።
በምድርም ከሚሰማ ወሬ የተነሣ አትፍሩ፤ ልባችሁም የዛለ አይሁን፤ በአንድ ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ በሌላው ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፤ በምድርም ላይ ግፍ ይነግሣል፤ አለቃም በአለቃ ላይ ይነሣል።
ስለዚህ እነሆ የተቀረጹትን የባቢሎንን ምስሎች የምበቀልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፤ ምድርዋም ሁሉ ትደርቃለች፤ ተዋግተውም የሞቱት ሁሉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ።
አጥፊዎች ከሰሜን ይመጡባታልና ሰማይና ምድር፥ በእነርሱም ያለው ሁሉ ስለ ባቢሎን ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ባቢሎንም በእስራኤል ስለ ተገደሉት ትወድቃለች፤ ስለ ባቢሎንም በምድር ሁሉ የተገደሉት ይወድቃሉ።
“ከሰይፍ ያመለጣችሁ ሆይ! ሂዱ፤ አትቁሙ፤ በሩቅ ያላችሁም እግዚአብሔርን አስቡ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በልባችሁ አስቡ።
We have been forsaken because of our sins; the people of the land have entered into our sanctuary, into the house of the Lord, and our countenance has fallen before them.
Therefore, behold, the time shall come when they shall be broken, saith the Lord; and all that are slain in her shall fall upon the earth.
Though Babylon ascends to heaven, and though she fortifies her strength, yet from me shall come destroyers against her, saith the Lord.
"The voice of a cry from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans is heard."
The Lord hath destroyed Babylon; and her great voice is silenced like the multitude of many waters; the noise of their cry is heard.
Destruction is come upon Babylon; her mighty men are taken; their bows are broken; for the Lord hath executed His vengeance upon her, and the Lord hath raised up the spirit of her adversaries.
I will also gather her mighty men and her wise men, her captains and her rulers, and her mighty men shall sleep a perpetual sleep, saith the Lord, whose name is the King of kings.

Thus saith the Lord of hosts: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labor in vain, and the nations shall be weary with the fire."

sections.title: The prophet Jeremiah sent a message unto Babylon.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah the prophet, when Zedekiah the king of Judah sent unto him to Babylon, unto Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign.
And Seraiah was a chief officer of the house; and all the evil that was to come upon Babylon, concerning all that is written in this book, Jeremiah wrote in one scroll.
And Jeremiah said unto Seraiah, “When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see all this, then read all these words.
O Lord! From man to beast, let none dwell therein, and let it be desolate forever, as Thou hast spoken concerning this place.
And after thou hast finished reading this book, thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the Euphrates.
And thou shalt say, ‘Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her.’”

sections.title: The Fall of Jerusalem

verses.text: Zedekiah began to reign when he was twenty-one years old; he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother was named Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
And Jehoiakim did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that he had done.
For the anger of the Lord was upon Jerusalem and Judah until He had cast them out from His presence; and Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

And it came to pass that in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
The city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which is by the king's garden; now the Chaldeans were against the city round about: and they went by the way of the plain.
But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army was scattered from him.
Then they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
የሴዴቅያስንም ዐይኖች አወጣ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሰንሰለት አሰረው፤ ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰደው፤ እስኪሞትም ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አኖረው።
በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በዐሥራ ዘጠነኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በዐሥረኛው ቀን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ፊት የሚቆመው የአዛዦች አለቃ ናቡዛርዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።
የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ ፥ ታላላቆችን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።
ከአዛዦችም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ሁሉ ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።
የአዛዦቹም አለቃ ናቡዛርዳን የሕዝቡን ድኆች፥ በከተማም ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የሕዝቡንም ቅሬታ አመጣ።
የአዛዦቹም አለቃ ናቡዛርዳን ከሀገሩ ድኆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።
ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበሩትን የናስ ዐምዶች በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናሱን ኩሬ ሰባበሩ፤ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።
ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎችን፥ መኰስተሪያዎችንና ድስቶችን፥ ጭልፋዎችንም፥ የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።
የአዛዦችም አለቃ ጽዋዎቹን፥ ማንደጃዎቹን፥ ድስቶቹንና ምንቸቶቹን፥ መቅረዞቹንና ጭልፋዎቹን፥ መንቀሎችንም፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም ዕቃ በብር አድርጎ፥ ወሰደ።
ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዐምዶች፥ አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከመቀመጫዎቹም በታች የነበሩትን ዐሥራ ሁለቱን የናስ በሬዎች ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ የናስ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ሚዛን አልነበራቸውም።
And the pillars were of one column, the height of each was eighteen cubits, and the circumference was twelve cubits; and the thickness was as a hand's breadth, and they were hollow.

And there were the capitals upon them, the height of one capital was five cubits; and upon the capitals all around were pomegranates, and there were also the capitals upon the second pillar, and the pomegranates were there.
On the outside were six Romanians; and all the Romanians that were upon the circumference of the enclosure were one hundred.
And the chief of the Azazim made the great priest Seraiah, and the second priest was Zephaniah, and the three were taken by the captains.

And from the cities, upon the captives, one was taken, and among those who stood before the king in the city, seven men were taken, the chief of the army, the scribe who was to bring the people of the land, and from the people of the land, sixty men were taken.
And the chief of the Azazim took Nabuzardan and sent him to the king of Babylon, to Deblatha.
And the king of Babylon smote them; and in the land of Emath, he slew them at Deblatha; thus Judah was taken from his land.
This is the people that was taken captive; in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews.
And in the eighteenth year of the reign of Nabuchadnezzar, eight hundred thirty-two souls were brought from Jerusalem.
In the twenty-third year of the reign of Nabuchadnezzar, the chief of the Azazim, Nabuzardan, brought from the Jews seven hundred forty-five souls; and all the people were four thousand six hundred.

sections.title: And it came to pass that Jeconiah was released.

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jeconiah king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twentieth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon sent and brought forth Jeconiah out of prison;
And he spoke kindly unto him, and set his throne above the thrones of the kings that were with him in Babylon.
And he changed his prison garments, and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
And for his diet, there was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
